jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact**

Foundry Business Group Operations is seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Sales Operations Analyst to support forecasting, demand planning, and business operations for Intel Foundry customers. This role serves as a critical bridge between Business Development, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance, ensuring customer demand signals are translated into actionable business insights and operational plans.

As a key member of the Foundry Sales Operations team, you will drive forecast accuracy, demand visibility, and data-driven decision making across the sales lifecycle. You will analyze customer demand trends, identify business risks and opportunities, and partner with stakeholders to optimize capacity allocation, inventory strategies, and revenue attainment.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, semiconductor industry knowledge, and business acumen to influence strategic planning and operational execution. This role will also act as the primary operations interface for Front-End (FE) Wafer demand planning and forecasting activities supporting Intel Foundry customers.

**Your responsibilities will include but not limited to:**

* Demand planning and forecasting processes for Intel Foundry customers, translating customer demand signals into actionable business plans.
* Manage production demand forecasting using Blue Yonder CDP and engineering demand planning within SAP IBP.
* Lead forecast reviews and demand planning cycles, ensuring alignment across Business Development, Strategy, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Partner with Business Development teams to establish forecasting readiness for new products, including product setup, demand assumptions, and lifecycle planning.
* Support Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Long-Range Planning (LRP) processes by developing data-driven demand scenarios and identifying planning assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
* Analyze customer forecasts, historical trends, market conditions, and demand patterns to improve forecast accuracy and business predictability.
* Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into demand, capacity utilization, inventory health, and revenue opportunities.
* Monitor forecast performance, including forecast accuracy, bias, and lag indicators, and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain and Manufacturing teams to align demand forecasts with available capacity, inventory strategies, and supply commitments.
* Partner with Customer Business Analysts to maintain accurate customer rolling forecasts and demand visibility.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Identify operational constraints, capacity gaps, and customer fulfillment risks, proactively driving mitigation strategies.
* Support new product introductions (NPI), engineering builds, high-volume manufacturing (HVM) ramps, and customer milestone execution.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance forecasting methodologies, planning processes, data quality, and operational efficiency.  

**Core Competencies**

* Strong communication and storytelling and the ability to influence stakeholders effectively.
* Innovation driven mindset with self-directed continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience translating complex data into actionable insights.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

The Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Minimum qualifications listed below would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experience and / or schoolwork/classes/research. The preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

  

**This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.**

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree.
* 6+ years of experience in semiconductor or manufacturing environments.
* 6+ years of experience in sales operations, demand planning, supply chain analytics, business planning or capacity planning roles.
* Proficiency in ERP systems commonly used in semiconductor manufacturing, such as SAP ECC or S4.
* Expertise in Sales and Operations Planning processes and supply chain planning systems (e.g., Blue Yonder, OneMPS COMPASS etc.).
Advanced working knowledge of Excel for data analysis and reporting.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Finance/MBA, Operations, or in a similar field.
* Familiarity with semiconductor wafer foundry operations and FPGA industry best practices.
* Experience with Foundry operations.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to navigate ambiguous business scenarios.  

Join us in shaping the future of semiconductor manufacturing. Bring your expertise, creativity, and passion to Intel's dynamic team, where your contributions will drive lasting impact and innovation.

jobs.description:
***Life changing work******\* Welcoming staff \* Generous benefits \* Advancement opportunities***

**Join the St. Vincent de Paul Society of San Francisco and be part of the solution to break the cycles of homelessness and domestic violence in San Francisco**.

St. Vincent de Paul Society of San Francisco operates the Multi-Service Center - Northern California’s largest homeless shelter, the Division Circle Navigation Center for chronically homeless individuals and couples and the Riley Center - Domestic Violence shelter and services for survivors. We have over 200 employees working in 4 locations. We are proud of our diversity and of our more than 150-year history of helping others in San Francisco. St. Vincent de Paul Society of San Francisco’s mission is to offer hope and service, on a direct person to person basis, working to break the cycles of homelessness and domestic violence.

**SUMMARY:**

This Case Manager III provides a full range of direct case management to clients at our MSC (Multi Service Center) homeless shelter. This position evaluates client needs and develops a service plan for approximately 25 active clients. This is a Full-time, non-exempt, Union position.

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 2:00pm to 10:30pm

**SALARY AND BENEFIT OVERVIEW:**

This Case Manager III starts at pays $30.60 per hour. St. Vincent de Paul Society of San Francisco offers a robust benefits package that includes:

* + Kaiser HMO medical paid in full
  + Voluntary dental, vision and life insurance
  + 403b retirement plan with employer-paid match after one year of employment
  + Employee Assistance Program
  + Ten vacation and ten sick days accrued per year, two personal floating holidays and twelve and a half holidays offered per year

**RESPONSIBILITIIES:**

* Provide direct client services: individual peer counseling, case management, advocacy, and accompaniment.
* Ensure Coordinated Entry Case Management Services at MSC are complying by regularly monitoring client activity related to achieving personal and programmatic goals.
* Conduct new client screenings: review applications and interview new clients.
* Client information must be entered into the ONE database within 48 hours.
* Create a service plan for each client with key issues prioritized.
* Partner with service providers to meet each client’s service plan goals by coordinating care.
* Assist clients in maintaining stability by offering support and linkage to services.
* Problem solves with the client to determine how best to assist the client.
* Observe clients passively, using Motivational Interviewing, to determine issues that need intervention.
* Facilitate meetings and support groups as needed.
* Develop client exit survey and case summary to support outcomes and program analysis.
* Maintain electronic client records in Salesforce, individual case files, daily logs, and service statistics in an accurate and timely manner.
* Participate in regular staff meetings including case management meetings and program development.
* Participate in on-going staff development and training, through employer and the required trainings with Dept. of Public Health.
* Perform other appropriate duties as assigned.

* BA degree in social services, psychology, or another related field. Equivalent work experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree.
* Case management experience required.
* Two years’ experience providing services to chronically homeless preferred. Relevant comparable experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated skills in counseling, case management, and client advocacy.
* Familiarity with the philosophy and approach of Harm Reduction, Motivational Interviewing and OARS.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills in English.
* Understanding of homeless issues, especially in context to race, class, gender, and sexual identity.
* Understanding of Housing First Approach to care for homeless population. Understanding of coordinated entry system.
* Knowledge, experience, and comfort working with a diverse community, including LGBTQQ, youth, immigrant, low-income communities, and communities of color.
* Proficient in using MS Office including Word, Outlook, and Excel.

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
**avfleet.ai** is a FaaS company that operates large scale depots that manage EV and AV fleets. In the Operations Supervisor role, you will lead our Operations Coordinator team and their driver cohorts. You will own the schedule, and be accountable for driver KPIs. If you like solving staffing problems in real time and are passionate about supervising high performing teams then this job is for you.  
  
**What you’ll do**

* Lead the coordinator team. Direct a team of Operations Coordinators who together supervise about 80 drivers — set priorities, resolve escalations, and hold the team accountable for their driver groups.
* Own the schedule. Build driver and Operations Coordinator shift schedules against forecasted volume, manage call-outs, and keep overtime under control.
* Develop people. Coach drivers and coordinators, run performance conversations, handle corrective action and nurture a culture of ownership, collaboration and sense of urgency.
* Keep timekeeping clean. Review and approve driver and coordinator hours, confirm meal and rest periods are recorded correctly, and ensure strict compliance with California wage and hour laws.
* Run the daily numbers. Track attendance, driver KPIs, and exceptions, and propose action plans for improving performance. Own the outcome when things go sideways. Direct the response to on-site incidents and vehicle events, figure out what changed, and make sure it gets reported and fixed.

**What you bring**

* Two or more years supervising or leading an hourly workforce in delivery, logistics, transportation, warehouse, or field operations — or an equivalent combination of experience and training
* Experience building schedules and managing timekeeping for 20 or more hourly employees
* Comfort with scheduling, timekeeping, and dispatch software, and with spreadsheets
* Availability for early morning, evening, and weekend shifts on a rotating basis
* Clear communication — you can coach someone and document it.
* A valid driver’s license, and the ability to meet our vehicle insurability standards and the driving-eligibility requirements of the delivery platforms we operate on. Operating our vehicles is an occasional part of this job, and no other form of transportation substitutes for moving a company van.

**We don’t require a degree for this role.**  
  
**Nice to have**

* Prior experience driving on a rideshare or delivery platform such as Uber or Lyft.
* Experience with EV fleets, charging operations, or other fleet depot operations.
* Working knowledge of California labor laws pertaining to overtime and meal and rest breaks.
* Conversational ability in Spanish.

**The work environment**  
This is an on-site role in an active vehicle yard. You’ll move between the office and the yard throughout the day, occasionally lift items up to 40 pounds, occasionally get in and out of vehicles, and work a schedule that includes early mornings, evenings, and weekends. If you need reasonable accommodation to perform any part of this job, we’ll work through it with you.  
  
**Compensation and benefits**  
Base salary: $72,050 – $75,000 per year. This is the good-faith range we reasonably expect to pay for this position on hire. Where you land in the range depends on your experience, skills, and internal equity.  
We also offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and California paid sick leave.  
  
**How to apply**  
Email your resume and the role you’re applying for to hiring@avfleet.ai  
We read every application — no automated screening, no resume-ranking software. A person reviews your materials.

Under the supervision of a pharmacist assists with healthcare service offerings including administering vaccines, health screenings, and any health services allowed by law.
* Within the guidelines of authorized company policies, state and federal laws/regulations, exercises independent judgment to delegate, direct, and assign non-clinical work in the pharmacy. Ensures tasks are completed on-time and holds others accountable for efficient workflow.
* At the direction of the Pharmacy Manager or pharmacist, prepares, and files reports and records required by the company and various government agencies.
* Manages core pharmacy workflow and drives excellence in pharmacy operations. Coordinates and organizes pharmacy daily schedule of activities. Recommends allocation of pharmacy hours. Assures the pharmacy is clean, neat, orderly, and stocked with adequate supplies.
* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in-place.
* Under supervision of the pharmacist, strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription-dispensing activities and understands their role in ensuring that the elements of Good Faith Dispensing are met.
* Maintains and applies knowledge of Company asset protection techniques. Supports Pharmacy Manager with diversion monitoring and reports any concerns that would compromise the security of the pharmacy to the Pharmacy Manager.
* Communicates prescription errors to the accountable pharmacist, and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Continuous Quality Improvement Program.
* Ensures the accurate processing of insurance claims to resolve customer issues and prevent payment rejections. Follows-up with insurance companies as well as medical providers and conducts or participates in 3rd party audit.
* Assists and supports Store Manager and Pharmacy Manager in analyzing and seeking to improve pharmacy financials, operational quality and customer service.
* Manages Community Outreach Portal and coordinates and, at the direction of the Pharmacy Manager, assigns pharmacists to off-site immunization clinics and community events. Builds and sustains relationships with retail partnerships.

**People & Performance Management**

* Leads performance management of technicians including making decisions and recommendations regarding discipline and termination. Follows constructive discipline policy to discipline, suspend, terminate or effectively recommend the same. Uses constructive discipline policy to ensure pharmacy technicians are compliant with state and federal laws. Holds technician accountable for attendance and timeliness. Maintains and improves performance of pharmacy through team member engagement and action planning.
* Accountable for technician hiring, on-boarding, training, and scheduling. Monitors and holds pharmacy technicians accountable for timely training completion. Follows established policies and procedures set by the company for scheduling and training.
* Accountable for identifying gaps in pharmacy operations knowledge among team members and supporting those team members in their training, either through hands-on training or assignment of learning modules.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager in monitoring that all pharmacy and team member licensures, registrations and certifications are active and in good standing/ compliant with all regulatory and legal requirements. Leverages Walgreens resources such as Walgreens Online Verification System to assist in documenting licensure status.
* Ensures proper procedures are followed for selection, recruitment, record retention, and trainin

jobs.title: Executive Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About SK hynix America:**

At SK hynix America, we are at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. As a global leader in HBM, DRAM, and NAND flash technologies, we develop the advanced memory solutions powering everything from advanced mobile technology to massive AI data centers. With major investments in the U.S. and a leading position in the global AI revolution, we build the critical infrastructure of the digital landscape and remain committed to sustainable operations. We invite innovative minds to be part of our journey. Here, you will be part of a collaborative team pioneering the next generation of memory technologies, expanding our market footprint, and defining the future of computing.

**Work Model:** Onsite

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Senior Executive Assistant to provide dedicated business support to our President. This role requires sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to anticipate needs in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.

The successful candidate will manage executive priorities, coordinate complex schedules and travel, prepare the President for key engagements, and ensure timely follow-through on commitments. This is a dedicated executive-support role, not a general office administration or personal-assistant position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage the President's calendar, aligning meetings and time allocation with business and relationship priorities.
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts, information gaps, and logistical risks, resolving or escalating issues promptly.
* Travel with the President as needed to provide on-site business and logistical support, including meeting preparation, stakeholder coordination, and follow-up on decisions and commitments.
* Coordinate domestic and international business travel, including detailed itineraries, meeting logistics, last-minute changes, and expense documentation in accordance with company policy.
* Maintain an organized view of the President's key business relationships, including stakeholder profiles, engagement history, relationship context, and follow-up commitments.
* Work with the President and the Strategic Planning team to prioritize external engagements, coordinate purposeful introductions, and identify opportunities to reconnect with key stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted liaison between the President, headquarters, internal teams, and external stakeholders, facilitating timely communication and coordinated action.
* Draft and coordinate executive correspondence, outreach, and follow-up communications aligned with the President's priorities, voice, and relationship context.
* As a member of the Strategic Planning team, collaborate with the team leader and team members to align meeting agendas, preparation materials, and follow-up activities with the President's strategic priorities.
* Coordinate high-priority internal, external, and recurring leadership meetings, ensuring clear objectives, relevant participants, focused agendas, and well-defined next steps.
* Work with the Strategic Planning team to prepare executive briefings, presentations, and decision-support materials.
* Attend selected meetings, document key decisions and commitments, and work with the Strategic Planning team and accountable stakeholders to track action items, flag delays, and follow through on outcomes.
* Handle confidential business, personnel, organizational, and relationship information with discretion and sound judgment.

**Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated experience supporting a senior executive in a complex business environment.
* Strong judgment, discretion, and the ability to prioritize competing demands independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience coordinating international travel and working across time zones.
* Strong attention to detail and reliable follow-through.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace, including calendar and presentation tools.
* Ability to work on-site and travel as required by the role.

**Benefits:**

* Top Tier health insurance at no employee cost
* Paid day offs: Paid Time Off, Company Holidays, Parental Leave, Happy Fridays
* 401k Matching
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for Health Care & Dependent Care
* Educational reimbursement up to $10,000 per year
* Donation Matching and volunteering opportunities
* Corporate discount programs
* Free Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner provided to employees

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**

SK hynix America is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender identity, national origin, color, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

In compliance with federal law, SK hynix America also participates in the federal E-Verify program. Upon accepting an offer of employment, all newly hired individuals will be required to complete Form I-9, which includes verifying identity and legal authorization to work in the United States. jobs.title: Senior Workplace Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

### **About the Role**

The Workplace Operations Sr. Manager is responsible for facilitating an exceptional office experience, providing operational support with a strong focus on customer service. You will work in collaboration with key stakeholders within and outside of the Workplace team to provide and maintain a top tier facility and employee experience. You are an individual who thrives in a fast paced evolving environment, who possesses strong communication skills, and the ability to successfully prioritize and execute tasks. You have a growth and development mindset, know how to stay self-motivated and lead with a positive attitude.

### **What You'll Do**

* Serves as the first point of contact, and face of the Workplace team for the Bay Area campus.
* Manage and foster professional development for the Bay Area Operations team.
* Facilitates an ongoing delightful employee experience by providing operational support and maintaining a well organized, visually pleasing facility.
* Manages, maintains, and enhances the Workplace programs (ex: mailroom operations, janitorial, food and beverage, etc.).
* Builds an active relationship with business partners and leaders to assess team allocations and occupancy needs as well as conference room usage. Provide proactive solutions, and improvement ideas through observation.
* Perform building audits to verify employee locations, furniture layout and room configurations are correctly noted in the space management tool.
* Coordinate with the Space Planning to maintain space standard ratios for on/offline rooms and office standards and solutions, as well as define space related programs to improve team member experience, as well as facilitate office moves.
* Facilitates and maintains relationships with building vendors, such as landlord, food and beverage partners, etc.
* Maintain budgets and track expenses for multiple different areas of the business.
* Acts as the single point of contact for all building related issues.
* Facilitates connecting employees to all aspects of the broader Verkada Business Operations teams.

### **What You Bring**

* A passion for providing exceptional customer service through human connection and ongoing operations support.
* 7+ years of management experience or related project management experience.
* 7+ years of workplace services experience.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across departments, work collaboratively.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, projects, and ever-changing priorities.
* Strong knowledge of mechanical systems (HVAC, FLS, plumbing, etc.) is strongly encouraged.
* Strong financial acumen with solid understanding of budget tracking & maintenance.
* Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

### **Employee Benefits**

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
* Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
* Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee's 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary
* Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
* Expanded mental health support
* Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
* Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
* Professional development stipend
* Wellness/fitness benefits
* Healthy lunches provided daily
* Commuter benefits

### **Additional Information**

* You must be independently authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

### **Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer**

As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

*Your application will be handled in accordance with our* *Candidate Privacy Policy**.*

jobs.title: Sales Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Operations Program Manager leads complex, cross-functional programs that enable sales teams to operate more effectively and deliver better client outcomes. A significant focus of the role is managing client portfolio alignment and transfers across large sales organizations, while also supporting broader sales operations priorities, including process improvement, performance insights, and program governance. The role translates business needs into clear plans and requirements, brings together the right partners, drives decisions, and ensures solutions are implemented with discipline and measurable results.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client portfolio program management**

* Lead recurring client portfolio realignment in support of the organization’s business banking client segmentation strategy.
* Oversee the portfolio transfer lifecycle, from client population scoping and data sourcing through approvals, assignments, communications, execution, and post-transfer stabilization.
* Develop and manage integrated plans with clear milestones, dependencies, decision points, owners, readiness criteria, and exit criteria for each transfer phase.
* Coordinate business leaders and subject matter experts across sales, data, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, enablement, and technology.
* Oversee the development and validation of transfer populations using agreed inclusion, exclusion, hierarchy, assignment, and ownership rules.
* Partner with data and business teams to reconcile source information, investigate discrepancies, resolve exceptions, and secure required approvals before execution.
* Coordinate transfer files and system updates across applicable platforms, maintaining clear controls, documentation, and contingency plans.
* Develop and coordinate banker readiness activities, including leadership alignment, role clarity, training, job aids, client context, communications, and escalation support.
* Monitor execution and post-transfer issues, drive timely resolution, confirm stabilization, and incorporate lessons learned into future transfer waves.

**Broader sales operations program leadership**

* Manage the intake, evaluation, prioritization, and staging of sales operations requests and enhancements based on business value, risk, effort, capacity, and strategic alignment.
* Lead cross-functional sales operations programs from concept and requirements through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Build program plans, establish governance routines, facilitate decisions, track risks and dependencies, and provide clear status updates to business and executive leaders.
* Design and implement practical process improvements that simplify work, strengthen controls, improve data quality, and create a more consistent experience for bankers and clients.
* Partner with sales leaders and frontline teams to identify operational needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve banker productivity and sales execution.

**Analytics and business insights**

* Define business questions, key performance indicators, measures of success, and reporting requirements for sales programs and operational processes.
* Partner with data and reporting teams to develop dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights for sales and business leaders.
* Analyze performance, adoption, operational trends, exceptions, and root causes to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Translate complex data and findings into clear recommendations, decisions, and actions for leadership.

**Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, process improvement, sales operations, sales enablement, banking operations, or a related client-focused environment.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving business teams and partners across data, technology, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, or sales.

  
**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Strong program-management skills, including planning, governance, requirements, issue and risk management, decision tracking, readiness, and implementation.
* Ability to analyze processes and data, identify root causes, develop recommendations, and translate findings into practical business actions.
* Experience gathering business requirements and partnering with technical or data teams through design, testing, implementation, and stabilization.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills, including the ability to create clarity, build alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor complex information for executives, sales leaders, bankers, and technical partners.
* Strong judgment, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against firm deadlines.

Preferred

* Experience supporting client portfolio transfers, sales coverage changes, segmentation initiatives, or large-scale client or account transitions.
* Experience with sales operations, CRM platforms, workflow tools, reporting solutions, automation, or sales performance programs.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Hogan CIS, Power BI, or comparable customer, account, workflow, and reporting tools.
* Experience with process design, continuous improv

jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
»

**Date:** Nov 24, 2026

**Location:** San Jose, CA, US

**Company:** Teradyne

We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world!

  

We attract, develop, and retain a high-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive.

  

**Our Purpose**

  

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.
  
  
We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
  
  
**Opportunity Overview**

The Operations Project Manager owns business continuity plans and manufacturing transfers across geographies for the instrumentation businesses within Teradyne's Product Test Group (PTG).

The role drives programs from post-NPI build through transfer to the global contract manufacturing network, volume ramp, and the sustaining stage. It balances high-volume production in Asia with local NPI and low-volume builds, demonstrating build-to-ship execution, and serves as the operations point of contact for cross-functional program teams.

Additionally, the role leads other programs as needed, including end-of-life management and the development of required manufacturing processes and tools through successful implementation.

**Key Deliverables**
====================

* Operations milestones (CM transfer through volume ramp) delivered on schedule and to cost and quality targets.
* CM ramp plans and schedules that meet customer demand and business objectives, demonstrated through build attainment and a successful ramp and transition to the sustaining stage.
* Material and clear-to-build readiness for each build phase, in partnership with supply chain.
* Manufacturing readiness at the CM (process, test, fixtures, capacity, Capex, and documentation) in place before ramp.
* Clear, timely reporting of program status, risks, and mitigations to PTG operations and business leadership.

**Measures of Success**
=======================

Success is measured by milestone and schedule adherence; first-customer-ship and ramp dates met; CM build attainment and on-time delivery; clear-to-build status; first-pass yield and quality; product cost versus target; E&O exposure from program changes; and open-issue closure rate.

This role requires working knowledge of electronics manufacturing (PCBA/SMT, electro-mechanical box build, and test) and, preferably, RF, photonics, or high-speed I/O instrumentation. The ideal candidate leads through influence in a matrix organization, working across internal teams (R&D, NPI and test engineering, supply chain, quality, sustaining, finance, and product management) and external partners (contract manufacturers, suppliers, and logistics providers).

Progressive experience in fast-paced organizations that respond to rapidly changing demand is a must, as is hands-on experience with contract manufacturers and NPI programs.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Operations Project Manager ensures that PTG programs and contract manufacturing partners meet schedule, on-time delivery (OTD), cost, and quality objectives. Key responsibilities include:

**Program Planning and Execution**
----------------------------------

* Build and own integrated operations schedules for each program, including CM transfer, first customer ship, and ramp.
* Run project core-team meetings and build-readiness reviews, tracking actions, dependencies, and decisions to closure.
* Manage multiple concurrent programs at different lifecycle stages, setting priorities across them.

**NPI and CM Transfer**
-----------------------

* Partner with R&D, NPI, and test engineering on manufacturability (DFM/DFT), test strategy, fixtures, and process qualification for ramp readiness.
* Lead product transfers to contract manufacturers, including documentation, training, test setup, and pilot builds.
* Coordinate engineering changes (ECOs) and revision cut-ins with minimal disruption to builds and inventory.

**Contract Manufacturer and Build Management**
----------------------------------------------

* Own day-to-day CM engagement, including forecast-to-build-to-ship oversight, build schedules, capacity, and on-time delivery, until products approach the sustaining stage.
* Monitor CM KPIs (build attainment, yield, quality, and cost) and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Resolve process, capacity, and material issues that threaten successful transfer and ramp, customer demand, and on-time delivery.

**Material, S&OP, and Cost**
----------------------------

* Provide program input to S&OP and build-plan reviews, aligning demand, supply, and capacity with supply chain and planning.
* Partner with supply chain on clear-to-build, long-lead and risk buys, and E&O exposure from program changes.
* Track product cost and operations budgets (including Capex for test equipment and fixtures) against targets.

**Risk, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------------

* Identify program risks early and drive mitigation and contingency plans.
* Prepare clear status, KPI, and risk repo

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Building Healthcare That Remembers**
======================================

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to.

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 345 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways.

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C at a $1.2 billion valuation from investors including Menlo Ventures and Lightspeed. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.

**About the Role**
==================

We're building a suite of products that helps healthcare organizations coordinate complex workflows across the patient journey. In this role, you'll work closely with our Chief Product Officer to drive our most important product initiatives and shape strategic decisions about where we invest and how we grow. You'll also connect engineering, product, and design with our go-to-market teams, helping teams plan across products and giving marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams what they need to launch products and support customers.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Own product planning across teams.** Keep roadmaps current, help teams prioritize shared platform capabilities, and make it easier for leaders to shift resources as company priorities and customer needs change.
* **Coordinate launches and product updates.** Give product marketing the timing and context to shape positioning, help sales and enablement teams prepare, and equip customer-facing teams to onboard and support customers. Build a repeatable process for letting sales engineering, product marketing, and enablement know when new capabilities are ready to demo.
* **Make product information easy to find and use.** Revamp the central source of truth for product plans and updates, establish standards teams can follow, and standardize dashboards for product metrics and competitive insights.
* **Drive priority initiatives with the Chief Product Officer.** Turn decisions into clear plans, keep owners and stakeholders aligned, and surface decisions and tradeoffs early.
* **Inform product and business strategy.** Translate competitive research, customer feedback, and market analysis into recommendations on annual product priorities, pricing, monetization, and expansion. Assess specialties and care pathways and recommend which to pursue first.

**What You Bring**
==================

* Experience in consulting, business operations, strategy, or a similar role that required you to bring structure to open-ended problems.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn research and data into clear recommendations.
* A track record of moving several initiatives forward at once, with clear owners, milestones, and decisions.
* The ability to build trust and drive alignment across technical, commercial, and executive teams.
* Curiosity about how products are built, brought to market, and adopted. You ask pointed questions, test assumptions, and help teams make better decisions. We welcome candidates whose experience is outside product management.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience at a high-growth technology company.
* Experience working in or closely with a product or marketing team.

**Benefits & Perks for Assorties**
==================================

* **Competitive Compensation** – Including salary *and* employee stock options so you share in our success.
* **Lifelong Learning** – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.
* **Office Setup Stipend** – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.
* **Top-Tier Health Coverage** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.
* **Flexible PTO** – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.
* **Meals & Snacks** – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.
* **Fitness Stipend** – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.
* **Commuter Benefits** – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.
* **401(k)** – Build your retirement savings.

**How We Work & What We Value**

jobs.description:

**Job Summary:**

The Project Manager oversees all aspects of the project and is responsible for co-ordination and completion of the project performing a variety of tasks. Tasks include analyzing drawings and specifications, setting deadlines, establishing schedules, procuring materials, tools & equipment, and monitoring and documenting progress of the project. The Project Manager may be responsible for more than one project at a time.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Manage projects to ensure that all scopes are completed per industry and job specific standards, and profitably.
* Operate and care for company equipment, vehicles, and small tools.
* Communicate with owners and consulting engineers to create comprehensive bids.
* Perform accurate take-offs.
* Constantly collect current pricing from vendors.
* Ensure all project details, materials, and scope clarifications are communicated and put together for the Foreman and crew.
* Upon an awarded contract, initiate the submittal process and assist with all necessary information.
* Ensure all materials have an assigned purchase order and complete all necessary paperwork as needed including change orders, additional product submittals, RFI’s, shop drawings, etc., in a timely manner.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Must be able to read and understand commercial plans, specs. and details.

* Must demonstrate knowledge and understanding of construction plans, OSHA procedures and requirements, and all aspects of waterproofing products and their installation.
* Must be able to create a comprehensive estimate for any project.
* Must be extremely self-motivated.
* Must be able to stay organized and multi-task current as well as pre and post project duties while also handling projects currently in the bidding process.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

* Must have a valid driver's license.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

jobs.title: Energy Storage Project Manager (Lost Hills, CA)
jobs.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Energy Storage Project Manager will provide leadership and oversight to an individual project. They will collaborate with multiple departments in planning, organizing, and directing the project work across our team, including engineering, scheduling, change management, budgeting, and closeout project documentation.  
  
This role is located full-time on a jobsite in Lost Hills, CA and will require travel. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Work with the project execution team to understand multiple work disciplines along with being a leader in scheduling, cost control, quantity tracking, procurement, client satisfaction, daily jobsite needs, and work activities
* Develop and maintain good relationship with Owner, Engineer, and Subcontractors; develop strategies and skills to build a strong partnership with the Owner, while still ensuring prompt owner notification of impacts and preservation of rights per the Prime Contract
* Maintain timely and accurate reporting to management, particularly with regard to cost forecasting and estimated cost at completion.
* Oversee preparation of project billings; seek to maximize cash flow in and reduce pay cycles through diligent & strategic billing preparation. Prioritize the collection of aged receivables and review their status regularly in Owner meetings and conversations.
* Present and negotiate change orders with owner for timely resolution.
* Coordinate, lead, and document routine project update meetings with client and internal stakeholders regarding the status and progress of the work
* Coordinate with the project team to identify needs, develop scopes of work, and hire appropriate third parties to execute the work
* Extensive coordination with material suppliers to ensure timely deliveries and to develop solutions to logistical and supply-chain challenges.
* Review contract conditions; ensure compliance with all contract terms
* Supervise documentation of all significant project events, e.g., accidents, delays, Change Orders
* Effectively manage project risk; evaluate probability and severity of risk events as they are identified / anticipated and prepare mitigation plans with project team and senior management
* Ensure jobsite office networking services are set-up (copiers/printers/scanners, phone lines, etc.)
* Enforce and promote a culture of safety by implementing and enforcing SOLV standards and OSHA policies, procedures and guidelines
* Assist the site management team in displaying and promoting the company values, tenets and culture while representing the company in a professional manner

**Objectives or Goals to Measure Performance:**

* Project profitability
* Project completed on schedule
* Customer/Client Satisfaction
* Positive project team attitude
* Adherence to Company policies and Corporate Procedures and Electrical Safety Manual
* Work within SE’s business processes and ensure an efficient working environment
* Improved personal professional growth and education
* Staff development and training

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of work-related experience in design and/or construction of utility scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Direct relevant industry experience preferred, skilled with knowledge related to the construction and operation of the electrical equipment and installation
* Leadership ability – able to pull together team members from diverse backgrounds in a remote environment and organize them into a cohesive, high-performing project team.
* Able to travel extensively (potentially more than 50%) including lengthy jobsite-based assignments.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills to work with others under all situations
* Ability to work, analyze, troubleshoot and prioritize problems independently
* Effective written and verbal English communication skills
* Proficiency and knowledgeable in office practices, procedures and equipment
* Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize and coordinate
* P6 scheduling experience preferred

**Physical Demands and Environmental Conditions:**

* Requires frequent stooping, bending, crouching, reaching, handling, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting 50 or more lbs
* Constant finger dexterity and ability to see details at close range and at a distance, hear, talk, and possess depth perception
* Occasional climbing and carrying, proximity to moving mechanical parts, working in high exposed places
Occasional exposure to environmental conditions  

  

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.*

SOLV Energy prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind against an employee or applicant based on race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, or ethnicity, mental or physical disability, veteran status, parental status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

**Your Role**

The Data Management team designs and delivers innovative cloud data platforms and services that enable enterprise decision-making and business outcomes. The Technical Program Manager, Principal reports to the Sr. Manager, Data Management & Integration Management and plays a critical role in defining, driving and evolving the commercialization and operationalization strategy for cloud-based data products and services. In this position, you will lead cross-functional execution across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Financial Management, Agile delivery teams, and business stakeholders to ensure strategic initiatives are delivered successfully and operationally ready for adoption. You will coordinate complex dependencies, manage program risks and milestones, facilitate decision-making, and provide leadership visibility into commercialization progress, readiness, and outcomes. You will also partner with Financial stakeholders to co-lead and manage the department Finance Budget, bringing financial budgeting expertise to planning, forecasting, and tracking of spend. The ideal candidate excels at navigating ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large-scale initiatives from concept through operational launch within an Agile/Waterfall delivery environment.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

  

**Your Work**

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead cross-functional commercialization and operationalization initiatives across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Financial Management, Agile delivery teams, and business stakeholders to drive successful delivery of cloud data services
* Shape and drive commercialization strategies, integrated program roadmaps, operating models, milestones, dependencies, and execution plans across multiple workstreams
* Define and evolve commercialization operating models, governance structures, and strategic roadmaps to support long-term platform growth and service adoption.
* Lead the alignment of service, operational, financial, and technical stakeholders to establish scalable commercialization models, service delivery frameworks, and long-term operating strategies
* Manage program-level risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and critical decisions while driving timely resolution and executive escalation when necessary
* Coordinate commercialization and operational readiness activities including service onboarding, intake processes, support model readiness, controls implementation, and organizational preparedness
* Facilitate governance forums, executive reviews, and stakeholder discussions to drive alignment, decision-making, accountability, and successful program outcomes
* Advise leadership on commercialization priorities, operating model evolution, investment tradeoffs, and strategic decisions impacting cloud data services
* Develop and deliver executive-level communications, reporting, and presentations that provide visibility into program health, risks, milestones, outcomes, and opportunities for continuous improvement
* Partner with Financial stakeholders to co-lead and manage the department Finance Budget, including budget planning, forecasting, variance tracking, and spend governance in support of program and commercialization priorities

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Generally, requires Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of Program Management, Technical Program Management, Technology Delivery, or related experience.
* Preferred: Minimum 5 years leading large-scale cross-functional programs involving Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and business stakeholders.
* Project Management certification (PMP, CAPM) preferred; Agile certifications (SAFe, Scrum, Agile Program Management) desired.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based technology platforms, data products, software delivery lifecycles, enterprise operational processes, and Agile/Waterfall delivery methodologies, including Agile planning practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Proven experience leading complex programs involving multiple workstreams, dependencies, stakeholders, competing priorities, and organizational change.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional alignment and execution across technical, operational, financial, and business domains while influencing decisions across multiple organizations.

jobs.title: Landscape Designer & Project Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**

Kalman Varga Design (KVD) is looking to bring on a new team member to grow our boutique residential landscape architecture firm. We are based in Noe Valley San Francisco, CA with semi-remote workers in the Bay Area. We are looking for highly motivated individuals who strive to create unique landscapes for residences ranging from urban pocket gardens to wine country estates. Our boutique firm relies on team members to wear many hats; from schematic sketching to construction detailing and coordination with city officials, contractors and clients. The principle, Kalman Varga, comes from an architectural background and takes pride in the detail and precision of the firm's drawings and architecturally oriented designs.

**THE POSITION**

Designer + Project Manager with a minimum of five years of professional experience in landscape architecture or architecture. This position is ideal for a well-rounded individual who can confidently take projects from conceptual design through construction documentation and implementation. The successful candidate will work closely with the principal while independently managing assigned projects, coordinating with consultants and contractors, and providing guidance and oversight to a junior designer. KVD is looking for someone who combines a strong design sensibility with practical construction knowledge and excellent organizational skills.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Site inventory, which may include hand measured plans for smaller urban projects.
* Collaboration in developing schematic concepts and feature design.
* Drafting and redlining of presentation, permit, pricing and construction drawings in Vectorworks.
* 3D modeling in SketchUp.
* Assisting junior design staff in furthering their construction detailing abilities.
* Partake in client presentations and site meetings and may be asked to lead these at times pending experience.
* Coordinate project detailing and logistics with contractors.
* Contractor, municipal, nursery, and sales coordination across numerous projects.
* Strategic project planning and scheduling.
* Onsite mock up review and plant layout.
* Procurement of plantings, furnishings, light fixtures and specialty features.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in architecture or landscape architecture from an accredited program.
* 5+ years of work experience in landscape or architecture. 2 years of project management experience.
* Authorized to work in the United States.
* Valid driver’s license, car, and ability to visit sites. The ideal candidate lives in the SF Bay Area. While the office is remote; the candidate will be asked to work in person twice a week in San Francisco.
* Must be able to manage multiple projects, budgets, orders and schedules simultaneously.
* Demonstrated experience producing complete landscape construction documents. KVD drafts and renders plans in Vectorworks. Vectorworks experience is not a requirement, but an interest in learning new software in the ever evolving technology market is a must.
* Experience coordinating with architects, engineers, and contractors.
* 3D modeling experience, preferably SketchUp. Rendering experience is plus, KVD is open to team members recommendation on rendering software, we currently Photoshop and use ChatGBT over SketchUp.
* Strong design and graphic sense with the ability to verbally and graphically communicate design ideas.
* Strong work discipline, with self-management skills. Initiative and problem solving are a must.
* A people person. KVD prides itself on being a boutique firm offering the highest level of customer service to our clients.
* KVD operates on Macintosh computers but the candidate may opt to use a PC or Mac.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Technical Program Manager

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Platform Architecture & Core Runtime: Architect, design, and lead the technical delivery of high-throughput, low-latency enterprise API gateway platforms and distributed backend services utilizing Java (JDK 17/21) ecosystems, ensuring robust traffic routing and policy enforcement.
* Distributed Data Strategy & Persistence: Define data architecture standards, caching strategies, and seamless schema migration frameworks across high-availability NoSQL and relational datastores (Apache Cassandra, PostgreSQL, ZooKeeper).
* Enterprise Delivery & Lifecycle Automation: Drive technical strategy for zero-downtime deployment automation, lifecycle orchestration, and installer tooling (Bash, Python, Linux packaging) across complex, multi-node enterprise environments.
* AppSec & Software Supply Chain Governance: Establish application security standards, lead vulnerability triage, and oversee third-party dependency/CVE mitigation frameworks across product release cycles.
* PKI, Trust & Cryptographic Architecture: Oversee enterprise-wide mTLS/TLS baselines, automated X.509 certificate governance, and compliance with FIPS-validated cryptographic standards across hybrid infrastructure fleets.
* Identity & Access Governance Architecture: Design and enforce enterprise authentication and federated identity architectures (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, fine-grained RBAC, and cloud IAM integration).
* Release Engineering & Delivery Pipelines: Direct end-to-end CI/CD strategy, multi-environment delivery pipelines, artifact governance, and software distribution channels for enterprise distribution.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Security Posture: Lead multi-cloud infrastructure strategy across AWS and GCP, prioritizing fleet hardening, network/firewall topology, load balancing architecture, and centralized key management (KMS).
* Technical Governance & Executive Escalations: Serve as the lead architectural escalation point for critical enterprise incidents, drive post-incident governance, and sponsor technical documentation, platform blueprints, and customer release roadmaps.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Programming & Scripting:

  + Strong production experience in Java (concurrency, networking, JVM/GC tuning, Maven/Gradle, JUnit, and multi-JDK runtime compatibility across JDK 8/17/21).
  + Advanced Bash / Shell scripting and Python 3 for Linux systems automation and CLI tooling.
* Distributed Databases & Messaging:

  + Hands-on experience operating and integrating with Apache Cassandra (CQL, driver tuning, JMX, cluster topologies) and PostgreSQL (streaming replication, major-version upgrades).
  + Working proficiency with distributed coordination and messaging systems (Apache ZooKeeper, OpenLDAP, AMQP/Qpid or similar brokers).
* Linux Systems, Networking & Web Proxies:

  + Deep knowledge of Enterprise Linux (RHEL, Rocky Linux, Oracle Linux, or Amazon Linux), systemd, Linux networking/firewalls (iptables), and RPM/Yum package management.
  + Experience configuring and troubleshooting NGINX or similar HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxies and load balancers.
* Security, Cryptography & Identity:

  + Practical experience fixing OWASP / CWE code vulnerabilities, performing CVE reachability analysis, and maintaining FIPS compliance.
  + Strong understanding of PKI, TLS/mTLS, X.509 certificates, KMS, and identity protocols (OIDC, SAML, LDAP).
* Cloud, CI/CD & Operational Excellence:

  + Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD build pipelines, Docker, and cloud platforms (GCP and/or AWS).
  + Proven ability to debug complex, multi-node distributed systems in production and write clear technical documentation and operational runbooks.
* Leadership & Background:

  + 8+ years of progressive leadership in software architecture, technical delivery ownership, or platform engineering for large-scale distributed systems or enterprise software platforms (B.S./M.S. in Computer Science or related field).

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Java

We are not a typical internal tools team. From recruiting to cultureance and growth systems, and scalable recruiting infrastructure. We operate in a highly cross-functional environment, partnering closely with HR, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and executive stakeholders.

We’re looking for a Program Manager to own execution, coordination, and delivery across People Innovation Labs’ most complex and cross-cutting initiatives. This role is distinct from the Product Manager role and is focused on **how** work gets done rather than **what** we build.

As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for translating product strategy into executable plans, managing dependencies across teams and systems, and ensuring that high-stakes initiatives land predictably and cleanly in a fast-growing, high-context environment. You’ll develop a deep understanding of how our products fit into users’ day-to-day work, what is working, and where they are struggling. You’ll also help keep the team aligned with its broader objectives. You’ll maintain a clear view of priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes across the portfolio and provide clear updates and recommendations to team and company leadership.

Our mission is to empower families who live and work in San Francisco to transform their futures through evidence-based educational and economic opportunities.

**Position Summary**

As the Operations Coordinator, you are an integrity driven person at the center of the day-to-day operations and activities at the Bayview Child Development Center. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and enjoys delivering great customer service in an educational setting. You have a passion for developing efficient systems to support operations and take pride in maintaining a welcoming, organized and safe environment. You are able to find harmony while holding multiple responsibilities and are thorough with everything you accomplish. jobs.description:
**Why choose us?**

Albertsons Companies is at the forefront of the revolution in retail. With a fixation on raising the bar with innovation and building belonging through our culture, our team is rallying our company around a unique purpose***: to create joy around each table and inspire a healthier tomorrow for every community.***

Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, with over 2,200 stores in 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners include Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Shaw's, Acme, Tom Thumb, Randalls, United Supermarkets, Pavilions, Star Market, Haggen, Carr’s, Kings Food Markets, and Balducci's Food Lovers Market. We support our stores with 22 distribution centers and 19 manufacturing plants.

  

**Bring your flavor**

Building the future of food and well-being starts with you. Join our team and bring your best self to the table.

Are you ready to lead a team in a fast-paced production environment? Join us as a Production Supervisor and be a key contributor to our production success. If you excel at motivating teams, managing production lines, and maintaining quality standards, we encourage you to apply.

**What you will be doing**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Manager serves as the site leader for Food Safety, Quality, and Regulatory Compliance at our beverage manufacturing facility. This role is accountable for protecting consumers, safeguarding beverage quality and shelf life, ensuring brand integrity, and enabling business growth.

The QA Manager leads and continuously improves the site’s Food Safety & Quality Management System (FSQMS) to meet and exceed FDA, FSMA, GFSI (such as SQF, BRC, or FSSC 22000), Organic, and customer requirements. Partnering cross-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Product Development, and Commercial teams, this leader mitigates microbiological and physical hazards, drives operational excellence, and supports new beverage commercialization. The role fosters a proactive food safety culture and uses data and continuous improvement tools to strengthen product quality, line capability, and regulatory readiness.

The position will be based in **Richmond, CA**.

  

**Main responsibilities**

* Lead Food Safety & Quality Systems: Own and continuously improve the site FSQMS—including HACCP, FSMA Preventive Controls, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), GFSI standards, Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures (SSOPs), Environmental Monitoring Programs (EMP), and allergen control—to maintain audit readiness and full compliance.
* Beverage & Process Quality Oversight: Oversee quality controls across incoming raw ingredients, water/batching, thermal or cold-chain processing, packaging lines, and finished beverages, including traceability and mock recall programs.
* Regulatory & Audit Leadership: Serve as the primary site contact for local, state, FDA, third-party, and customer audits. Lead inspections, regulatory responses, and timely Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) closure.
* Product Safety Authority: Make final decisions on product release, quality holds, deviations, concessions, and disposition. Oversee analytical and microbiological lab testing, sanitation and CIP verification, and hold/release workflows.
* Quality Team Leadership: Build and lead the QA and lab team through mentorship, clear accountability, strategic hiring, structured onboarding, and ongoing skill development.
* Data-Driven Improvement: Establish beverage quality KPIs and use trend analysis, complaint investigation, and root cause analysis to reduce risk, prevent repeat non-conformances, and drive continuous improvement.
* Supplier & Customer Quality: Lead supplier quality programs and manage customer complaint investigations, trend tracking, and resolution.
* Commercialization & Change Management: Partner with R&D, Operations, and Commercial teams on new product launches, packaging or formula trials, and Management of Change (MOC) to verify food safety and quality standards before execution.

  

**What we are searching for**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in food science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or a related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of progressive QA management experience in food, beverage, or bakery manufacturing.
* Certifications: Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) and HACCP required or attainable shortly after hire; GFSI/SQF Practitioner certification preferred.
* Technical & Regulatory Knowledge: Strong command of FDA/FSMA regulations, GMPs, allergen and sanitation controls, lab/microbiological practices, and CAPA/root cause tools.

  

**What is it like at Albertsons?**

Our 290,000 associates have a passion for great service and building lasting relationships with our customers. Through a companywide focus on innovation, we are continually enhancing our digital and product offerings, making it easy for customers to get what they need, wherever they are.

Gator Bio is a Tech Bio company located in Palo Alto, CA. We are creating innovative technologies to solve difficult problems facing today’s biopharma industry. We are also entering the business of agentic scientific robots and autonomous wet labs.

* Coach non quality personnel.

In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s retail stores, workplaces, and workplace services. The Program Operations team sets the standards, controls, and reporting that keep the PMO running cleanly, so leaders, partners, and business unit owners work from one shared view of what is planned, what is on track, and what needs attention. jobs.description:
**About Frec**
--------------

Frec is building the modern investment platform for high-net-worth investors. We combine self-directed investing with continuously managed strategies in a single brokerage account, bringing capabilities traditionally delivered through wealth managers directly to our customers.

We see AI as a way to make sophisticated investing more personal and intuitive. The investment infrastructure we’ve already built gives us a foundation to help customers make better decisions without giving up control of their financial lives.

Customers have entrusted us with $1.5 billion in assets, up 4x in the last year. We’re backed by Greylock and have reached this scale with a small team. The people who join now will help build the primary investment platform for a new generation of investors.

**The role**
------------

As an early member of Frec's Investor Experience team, you'll play a critical role in building lasting customer relationships and shaping how we serve investors as we scale.

You'll own the post-onboarding customer relationship, acting as a knowledgeable and trusted point of contact for investors with increasingly sophisticated financial needs. Your goal is to ensure customers understand the value of Frec’s investment strategies, feel confident using our platform, and have an exceptional experience throughout their relationship with Frec.

This role requires investment fluency, analytical thinking, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to make complex financial concepts accessible. You'll help customers understand everything from direct indexing and tax-loss harvesting to long short strategies, portfolio leverage, financing costs, and investment performance.

Beyond working directly with customers, you'll help build the systems, processes, and standards that define how Frec delivers an exceptional investor experience at scale.

**What you'll do**

* Own the post-onboarding customer relationship, building trust and driving long-term engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
* Help investors understand their portfolios, investment strategies, performance, tax-loss harvesting, fees, and financing costs.
* Investigate complex customer issues, taking ownership from initial discovery through resolution.
* Partner with product, engineering, and brokerage operations to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, and resolve issues.
* Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction or disengagement and develop strategies to address them.

* Own and improve key customer experience metrics, including NPS, CSAT, customer health, retention, and response times.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI, and better processes.
* Collect and synthesize customer feedback to influence product development and business priorities.
* Partner with sales and marketing to create a seamless experience across the entire customer journey.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 4+ years of experience in wealth management, brokerage, fintech, customer success, or a related client-facing financial services role.
* SIE, Series 7, and either Series 65 or Series 66 credentials in good standing.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, brokerage accounts, margin, leverage, and financing costs.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with sophisticated investors.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working with CRM and customer engagement platforms, such as HubSpot.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented approach. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating problems independently, and building processes where they don't yet exist.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus opportunities
* Meaningful equity ownership in a fast-growing company
* Fully covered health and dental insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Monthly wellness stipend to support physical and mental health
* Flexible paid time off
* Daily in office lunch
* The opportunity to build and shape a core function at an early-stage fintech company

Startup experience as well as familiarity with direct index and tax loss harvesting concepts is a plus! If you’ve worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement listed.

Must be able to work on-site 4 days/week from either NYC or SF

Compensation Range: $130K - $170K
