jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We are Rippling’s sherpas – both for our customers and colleagues. We bring our customers along on the journey as we rapidly enhance and expand the first-of-a-kind employee management platform. We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid-remote US-based Account Management team.

You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. Account managers in our Strategic segment own revenue retention and growth of our largest customers.

* Ensure our customers in the Core channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.

* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based selling approach.
* Navigate a sales process by building relationships with multiple stakeholders through remote meetings.
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to quarterly targets.
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting.
* Partner with your Technical Account Manager to devise account plans, long-term goals, and client strategies; and with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a sales discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long-term commercial relationships (experience managing multi-year renewals)
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

* **Commission is not guaranteed**

132,000 - 220,000 USD per year(US Tier 1)

**About Us**
============

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

Our partners help customers build, deploy, and get value from LangChain. Our services work spans engagements delivered by LangChain teams, external partners, and both together. You’ll partner with Partnerships, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Deployed Engineering, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and GTM Systems. Partner and services leaders will continue to own their relationships, program policies, and delivery decisions; you’ll own the operational systems, processes, and data that make those decisions work at scale.

* Build reliable reporting for partner activity and performance, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, using agreed definitions and clear data-quality standards.
* Coordinate partner-facing resources, communications, and operational handoffs so managers and partners know where to go and what to expect as programs change.

### **Run and scale partner support**

* Own the partner support operating model: intake, routing, severity definitions, service levels, escalation criteria, case ownership, and handoffs to teams with the right expertise.
* Stay close to partner issues and escalations, especially sensitive or high-impact cases. Review misrouted requests and recurring issues, and improve the underlying rules and knowledge—not just the individual case.
* Lead and coach partner support resources and plan coverage as demand grows. Where outsourced support is used, manage vendor performance through onboarding, training, quality reviews, calibration, operating reviews, and corrective action.
* Maintain a consistent knowledge layer across partner-facing guidance, support responses, and AI-assisted content. Keep it current as policies and programs change.
* Use support and outcome data to identify opportunities for self-service and automation, with human review where a wrong answer or action carries risk.

### **Create the operational backbone for services**

* Build repeatable processes for internal, partner-led, and joint services engagements, from opportunity intake and scoping through staffing, delivery, closeout, and handoff.
* Provide hands-on operational support to AEs on services deals: help determine the right SKU, pricing, whether charges are recurring or non-recurring, and the limits of services commitments the team can make. Partner with Services, Finance, and Deal Strategy & Operations on decisions and exceptions.
* Document services deal guidance, decision rules, and escalation paths, then partner with Deal Desk to transition repeatable deal support into its operating model as volume grows. Keep guidance current as offerings and policies change.
* Partner with services and engagement leaders to maintain clear engagement records, statements of work, milestones, deliverables, budgets, staffing plans, and risks. Support resource and capacity planning without taking ownership of technical delivery.
* Coordinate operational handoffs for external delivery partners, including onboarding, scope and rate documentation, time or milestone tracking, partner costs, and invoice review, in partnership with services, Legal, and Finance.
* Track engagement health and outcomes, including delivery progress, customer milestones, time to value, utilization, budget variance, and partner delivery performance. Help leaders distinguish activity from customer outcomes.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Chooch is seeking a motivated, hands-on Healthcare Field Implementation Specialist to support the deployment of AI-powered inventory management solutions in hospitals.

This role combines customer engagement, supply room organization, equipment assembly and camera installation. You will work directly with nursing, supply chain and internal deployment teams to improve supply availability and prepare inventory environments for computer vision technology.

Team members will be trained across all stages of deployment, with opportunities to specialize based on their strengths and interests.

**Role Responsibilities**
-------------------------

**Site Surveys**

* Capture room measurements, photographs, rack configurations and inventory layouts.
* Identify camera placement, power requirements and physical constraints.
* Document site conditions and deployment requirements.

**Nursing Engagement**

* Facilitate structured item grouping and supply room design sessions with nursing teams.
* Review recommended PAR levels with nursing and supply chain teams and document feedback.
* Incorporate approved feedback into supply room layouts.

**Supply Room Transformation**

* Review, modify and validate planograms based on onsite conditions.
* Assemble racks, bins, dividers and associated hardware.
* Label storage locations and organize inventory according to approved layouts.
* Execute rack exchanges and inventory transfers while minimizing disruption to clinical operations.

**Camera Installation**

* Install, connect and provision cameras and mounting hardware.
* Validate camera positioning, connectivity, image quality and inventory visibility.
* Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues.

**Deployment Support**

* Complete deployment checklists and maintain accurate documentation.
* Provide short-term onsite support following go-live.
* Address nursing feedback and support approved layout adjustments.
* Communicate progress, issues and opportunities for improvement.

  
**Requirements**  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 0–2 years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Mechanical aptitude and comfort using basic tools.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Comfort using computers and mobile applications.
* Ability to follow procedures, solve problems and work collaboratively.
* Ability to perform hands-on equipment assembly, installation and inventory handling, with reasonable accommodation as applicable.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in healthcare, supply chain, inventory management or field operations.
* Familiarity with medical supplies, shelving systems or inventory organization.
* Experience with equipment installation, cameras or connected devices.
* Customer-facing experience.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

* Full-time, onsite at an assigned hospital system.
* Regular interaction with nursing, supply chain and facilities teams.
* Adherence to hospital safety, privacy and infection prevention requirements.
* Flexibility to accommodate deployment schedules and clinical operations.

  
**Benefits**

Chooch offers competitive salary commensurate to candidate experience with extensive benefits including health, dental, vision insurance, 401K with 3% match, extensive PTO, and life insurance policies included.

-------------------

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**Global Operations Specialist**
--------------------------------

**Help our customers improve their global supply chains**

**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

At Flexport, we know global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global trade easier for everyone. Flexport today connects more than 10,000 clients, both consignees and shippers, across 112 countries. Our role is to help businesses of all sizes find the global trade solutions that will empower their success.

Now more than ever, customers need our support to survive and win in 2026. Their success is our success. We work back from what's best for them to find a solution. That's why we are building the Platform for Global trade - a strategic model combining customer centricity, supply chain expertise, advanced technology, and data analytics.

As a Global Operations Specialist, you are responsible for executing the shipment lifecycle for Ocean & Air shipments, ensuring data integrity is maintained at the highest standard, and proactively minimizing delays with urgency.

As a new team member in our North American Operations group, you'll begin by immersing yourself in our company culture and mastering world-class operations. As Flexport continues to grow, there could be opportunities for future Flexporters to become founding team members in new markets, relocate internationally, and help us expand our presence around the world. If you're interested in a fast-paced career with the potential for international experience, this opportunity could offer you unmatched growth and adventure.

**You will:**
-------------

* Be responsible for executing the movement of ocean and air freight shipments from booking at origin to final delivery at destination.
* Maintain communications with Flexport transportation and warehousing partners to facilitate the progress of shipments in transit.
* Work and communicate cross-functionally within Flexport
* Be a part of the frontline groups ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on time and exceptions are handled appropriately.
* Use metrics to spot opportunities to improve and deliver great performance in your role.
* Own the data quality of our client's information by validating booked shipments, tracking client shipment status, and validating shipment schedules.
* Consistently follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure that your work satisfies internal Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service-Level Agreements (SLAs) in line with productivity goals.

* Team-centric mindset: obsessed with team outcomes, doing what it takes to deliver the team's and their client's expectations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail in a high-energy, fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in Google Suite/Microsoft Suite (Sheets/Excel).

jobs.description:
### **In Some Jobs You Take Orders. In This One, You Write History.**

Join the healthcare information technology team that’s turning drug and medical device data into knowledge used by thousands of hospitals, the majority of U.S. health plans, retail pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers, and millions of health care decision-makers throughout the world. Partnering with our information system developer and healthcare institution customers, you’ll help evolve leading-edge thinking into reality and make a measurable difference in improving human health.

We’re looking for people who are intelligent, productive, committed, willing and able to go above and beyond, passionate about making a difference, innovative and energized. You’ll play an essential role in a successful company’s continued growth.

**Are you ready for this exciting challenge?**

First Databank (FDB) is currently seeking a Customer Support Representative. This is the first human point of contact for FDB customers. You resolve customer questions, own customer outcomes from start to finish, and help the team adopt AI-assisted support tools as they’re introduced. As AI takes on more routine work over time, the role will shift toward judgment, checking AI output for quality, reaching out to customers before they ask, and spotting customers at risk of leaving.

This position is based out of our San Francisco, CA office and follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation to work onsite at least three days per week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Resolve customer questions and common product problems across support channels as the first point of contact.
* Act as the customer’s contact for cases that need FDB’s expert teams. This includes taking in the request, routing it, explaining the expert’s answer to the customer and seeing the case through to closure.
* Follow up on cases waiting for resolution. Use available tracking tools and automation as they’re introduced.
* Spot frustrated or at-risk customers and flag them for follow-up.
* Escalate technical or complex issues to Technical Support with complete case notes.
* Use AI-assisted tools (drafting, summarizing, knowledge search) where available. Check and personalize all AI-generated content before it reaches customers and make sure any answer involving drug or clinical information gets qualified human review.
* Take part in AI pilots: test the tools, give feedback, and report wrong or missing answers to the Team Lead and AI Knowledge Owner.
* Check in with customers proactively, support onboarding, and follow up with dissatisfied customers.
* Write and update help articles so customers can answer routine questions themselves.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Cases resolved per week.
* First-contact resolution rate and median time to resolution.
* CSAT maintained or improved; reopened-case rate flat or declining.
* Adoption of AI tools and quality of feedback during the rollout.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Customer support experience in software, healthcare IT or a related field. Familiarity with drug databases or clinical content is a plus.
* Strong writing and judgment.
* Openness to using AI tools and willingness to help shape how the team uses them.
* Demonstrated empathy and de-escalation skills, and the ability to spot signs a customer may leave.

**Accommodations**
------------------

We are committed to an accessible application process. If you need an accommodation to apply, please contact accommodations@fdbhealth.com . This email address is for accommodation requests only.

**Benefits**
------------

This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; a flexible spending account; paid holidays; paid time off; an employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

**Compensation**  
  
The base salary range below is the Company's good-faith estimate for this position in the posted work location at the time of posting. Final starting salary will be based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, certifications, education, location and market considerations.

Base Salary Range:

$58,000 — $72,000 USD

The Grid Research, Innovation and Development (GRID) organization, part of PG&E's Strategy & Growth business unit, finds, tests and scales new solutions that help the grid serve California's fast-growing electricity demand safely, reliably and affordably. ##### **Who We Are**

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

##### **Overview**

The Digital Delivery Program Coordinator (DDPC) supports digital delivery execution on a single data center project, administering the Digital Delivery program across cross-platform data so that project-level tracking, meeting records, action logs, reporting inputs, and information flow stay current across every digital delivery workstream. The role reports to the Digital Delivery Program Manager on a single-site assignment.

The DDPC is the central driver for project data flow and performance visibility in a multi-prime infrastructure environment. The role maps cross-platform data sources, administers Delivery Control System (DCS) inputs, and translates spatial, financial, and logistical updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards. The DDPC manages the single source of truth across the full project lifecycle, works from a philosophy of evidence-driven decision making, and can build and deploy custom automated tools to measure digital asset readiness from design through operational handover. By acting as the clearing house for information flow and preventing data fragmentation, the DDPC protects the critical path of the build and frees the Program Manager to focus on campus scope, program-level risk, and client strategy.

This is a project-level coordination role rather than a technical BIM or VDC lead role. The DDPC supports program scope but does not set it, and does not own overall digital delivery strategy, multi-campus program governance, final CDE governance standards, VDC coordination execution or model quality approval, OFE procurement decisions, commissioning strategy, final handover requirements, or executive client messaging. jobs.title: Possibly the Best Operations Manager Job in the Online Health Space
jobs.description:
**Naturally Clear Vision Institute is hiring an Operations Manager (with real growth potential)**

You've probably never seen a job posting like this one.

We're Naturally Clear Vision Institute. We teach people how to improve their eyesight naturally through online programs, live coaching, and a membership community that renews at up to 91%. Our founder, Claudia Muehlenweg, also hosts a bi-weekly YouTube livestream for 103,000 subscribers. The product works. The community loves it. The mission is real.

If you've ever wondered whether people can really take their glasses off for good without drugs or surgery, you'll love what we do here. And right now, we need the person who makes it all run.

**A few things to know up front**

This is a 1099 contractor role with no benefits.

Claudia is a creative, big-picture founder with lots of ideas. She often shares them by voice note, and you'll help sort them into clear priorities and next steps. She's open and honest with feedback, and she appreciates the same in return.

Launch seasons get busy. Some of our SOPs need a refresh, and we're in the middle of moving to GoHighLevel, so you'll have a real hand in shaping how things work going forward.

We have 2 team meetings each week that you'll be part of. Claudia sometimes works on European time when she travels, so a little flexibility helps.

If this sounds like the kind of place you'd enjoy, keep reading.

**This might not be the right fit if...**

* You do your best work with step-by-step direction.
* You find it hard to push back on ideas.
* You'd rather implement every request as-is than talk it through first.
* You haven't run a launch from start to finish yet.
* You'd prefer not to work with AI tools.
* You feel more at home in a slower, more predictable pace.

None of that is a bad thing. It just means another role may suit you better.

**Who we're hoping to meet**

**You're the steady one when things get busy.**

When you hear a big idea, you naturally start sorting what matters now, what can wait, and who's best to own it.

You'd rather build systems that keep work moving than spend your day following up.

**You've run operations for an online business before.** You know what a launch calendar looks like, from cart open to cart close.

You've managed VAs who work in different time zones and you've built SOPs that people actually open and use.

You get genuinely excited about AI and automation because it frees up the humans on your team to do work that matters.

You check the numbers before you sign off on a plan, and you're comfortable saying out loud when something doesn't add up.

**You care about the mission here. You want to work on something that helps people understand they have real agency over their health. You're not just looking for a job. You're looking for a place to actually build something.**

If you've read this far and this sounds like you, use the subject line "Glasses Off" when you apply.

**What you'll actually be doing**

**Be Claudia's right hand.** You run the weekly 1:1. You take her voice notes and turn them into decisions with owners and dates. You protect her from becoming the bottleneck in her own company.

**Run the operations rhythm.** Monday ops meeting. Thursday team meeting. Every meeting ends with owned, dated tasks and no ambiguity about who does what.

**Lead a remote team and own execution across the business.**

You'll directly manage a remote team of four: a tech VA, an admin VA, a client care specialist, and a social media manager. You'll also work closely with our coaches and program director, coordinating their priorities and making sure their work lines up with the rest of the team's.

You won't be doing every task yourself, but you will have full visibility into what's happening across execution, marketing, and course implementation. You're the person who knows what's in motion, what's stuck, and what needs attention, and you keep work moving across the whole organization.

You support a tech VA, an admin VA, a client care person, and social media and help each person set clear KPIs, own their results and grow in their role.

**Own every launch from calendar to close.** You guide promos and launches from start to finish, and review the work before it reaches Claudia so everything goes out polished.

**Handle what support can't.** Member escalations that need a senior decision land with you. Then you fix the root cause so the same thing doesn't happen twice.

**Build the systems that run the business.** Automations, AI workflows, updated SOPs. You keep the operational infrastructure current and actually functional.

**Watch the money.** You monitor cash flow and software spend. You bring Claudia options before things get tight, not after.

**Work cross-functionally.** You collaborate with Program Director Amber, the CMO, and outside contractors handling ads and the website. You're the connective tissue.

**What success looks like at 90 days**

You've run a full launch using a launch calendar and 1 offer sheet, with everything reviewed before it went live. Claudia gets decisions as clear options with your recommendation. Every team member knows their 3 to 5 KPIs and feels confident owning their work.

**What you need to bring to this role**

jobs.description:
#### **About Us**

Collective Goods Holdings, Inc. (CGH) is a privately held holding company behind Books Are Fun, Inc. — a company with a simple but powerful mission: to inspire lifelong readers by getting kids excited about books. Books Are Fun energizes communities, schools, and families to ensure every child has books at home, because we believe reading can change the world.

To learn more about our companies and how we spark a lifelong love of reading, please visit our website at **https://booksarefun.com/book-blast**

#### **Position Summary**

Books Are Fun is seeking a dynamic, relationship-oriented **Customer Success Associate** (CSA) to join our mission-driven team. This high-impact, client-facing role reports to a Senior Customer Success Manager, focusing on delivering white-glove service to schools participating in our Book Blast program, ensuring they have an outstanding experience from onboarding through renewal.

The ideal candidate is passionate about customer experience, thriving in a sales-driven environment, who anticipates client needs and consistently delivers a wow experience.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Success & Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for schools throughout their Book Blast journey, from onboarding to renewal.
* Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with school leaders through personalized outreach and proactive problem-solving.
* Implement retention strategies based on Never Lose a Customer Again principles to maximize renewals and engagement.
* Use data-driven insights to highlight program impact and promote future participation.

**Sales Support & Collaboration**

* Facilitate smooth transitions of new schools from sales to customer success.
* Partner closely with the Regional VP to align on client needs and retention efforts.
* Provide valuable feedback on customer insights, program enhancements, and growth opportunities to leadership and marketing.
* Develop and execute engagement strategies that maximize participation and event results.

**Executive Support & Process Improvement**

* Support the Regional VP with communication and project coordination, as needed.
* Identify friction points in the customer journey and refine processes to create effortless experiences.
* Maintain organized, detailed records of client accounts, communications, and outcomes.

**Training & Development**

* Participate in ongoing training and coaching to deepen knowledge of customer success best practices, sales techniques, and program details.

**Obtain Referrals, Testimonials, and/or References**

* Encourage and gather testimonials, referrals, and client advocacy to grow the Books Are Fun network.
* Leverage client satisfaction to build a network of advocates for Books Are Fun.

#### **Key Requirements**

* Strong communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-centric mindset with passion for creating exceptional experiences and long-term loyalty.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities seamlessly.
* Energetic and enthusiastic - you love books and enjoy sharing that excitement with clients.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* **Skills:** Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
* **Personality:** Customer-oriented with a passion for going above and beyond to meet client needs. Comfortable meeting new people every day and engaging with them directly.
* **Attitude:** Positive, proactive, and enthusiastic about helping others succeed.

**Preferred but not Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience in Sales, Customer Success, or Customer Service
* Experience with CRMs

#### **Why Join Us:**

* Be part of a team dedicated to making a positive impact on education.
* Growth Opportunity and Professional Development: As Books Are Fun continues to grow, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with it. You'll have the opportunity to deepen your expertise, take on greater ownership within your role, and contribute to shaping our customer success function as it scales.
* Collaborative and enjoyable team environment.

#### **Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Health insurance
* Flexible Spending Account/Health Savings Account/Dependent FSA
* Supplemental benefits (critical illness, accident, & hospital indemnity)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Internet stipend
* Company paid life insurance + buy-up option
* Company paid short-term & long-term disability insurance
* 13 paid holidays throughout the year
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Volunteer Time Off
* Work from home
* Cultural connections such as our Quarterly Book Club

#### **Pay**

This is a full-time salaried exempt role paying $50,000-$56,000 annually with Performance Bonuses paid seasonally.

#### **Working Conditions:**

* This is a remote position.
* **Please note: We are currently only hiring in AL, AZ, CA, CO, DE, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KY, MD, MO, NC, NE, NV, NY, OH, PA, SC, TN, and TX. Applicants outside these states will not be considered.**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Lightfully provides treatment on a full continuum of care including residential, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and virtual services. With current communities providing best-in-class care in Southern California markets, Lightfully is positioned for dynamic and high-paced growth.

Welcome to a behavioral health services company unlike those that have come before it. One where leaders believe in the healing and nourishing quality of compassion both in treating clients and caring for our people. A safe place to bring your whole self to work and infuse a bit of your own magic into what you do every day. The Lightfully Shining Commitments reflect our commitment to these principles and encourages our staff to deliver exceptional performance through their authenticity, bravery, and grit. We believe that great things can happen when we create space for people to *light fully*.

**Job Summary:**

The Virtual Program Manager (VPM) manages the daily operations of virtual-specific programs. Actions include but are not limited to: direct care (Client Care Specialists) management, milieu management, client admissions and discharges, and supporting other client needs. The Virtual Program Manager serves as a leader within the virtual program and works closely with the Director of Clinical Operations to assist as needed. The Virtual Program Manager plays an integral role in the achievement of program goals and creating and sustaining Lightfully Behavioral Health clinical mission and culture.

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Upholds and maintains the Company, mission, and values (called the Lightfully "Shining Commitments").
* Provide supervision, support and coaching to employees. Other management activities include (but are not limited to):

* + Interviewing, hiring, goal development, onboarding and ensuring continuous training requirements and compliance items are met.
  + 1:1 and team meetings to discuss successes, challenges, new projects, innovations, company changes, etc.
  + Timely coaching and disciplinary action (delivery and documentation), as needed.
  + Completing performance reviews for employees within company designated timeframes.
* Maintain employees' timecards in the Payroll system, ensuring the correct hours are accounted for, overtime is managed, and paid-time off requests are promptly addressed.
* Oversees operational aspects of assigned programs.
* Reviews Client Care Specialist (CCS) documentation to ensure timely and accurate reporting of program events and groups.
* Schedules team members to census, with the ultimate goal of minimizing overtime and use of temporary staff.
* Coordinates admissions/transitions to program and discharges/transitions out of program, working closely with the Director of Clinical Operations, Admissions Team, Client Finance, and/or receiving facility.
* Provides orientation and support for new clients as they adjust to the milieu.
* Works with team to find new ways to staff efficiently, optimize staff strengths and ensure the highest level of client care.
* Completes accurate and timely documentation of interactions and communication with clients.
* Reviews Perception of Care results and make revisions/suggestions to program offerings as needed.
* Ensures that incident reports are completed and sent to Director of Clinical Operations for review.
* Upholds client confidentiality and maintains professional boundaries, demeanor, dress and interaction with clients, family members, visitors, and coworkers.
* Works closely with the Compliance Department to ensure an environment of safety and Compliance (as appropriate to level of care).
* Performs other duties, as assigned.

**Specific Skills/Competencies:**

* Excellent management and supervisory skills.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Proficient computer literacy in Microsoft Office programs, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to navigate HIPAA compliant telehealth platforms and Electronic Medical Record systems.
* Ability to speak English fluently; ability to speak Spanish, preferred.
* Ability to communicate and write clearly and professionally is required.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Strong communication skills. Must have the ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from clients, referents, and the public.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must have the ability to communicate with individuals over phone and via electronic correspondence.
* Able to work for prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

**Mental/Social Requirements:**

* Must be able to demonstrate working effectively with and showing respect to all clients/patients and staff, including those from diverse ethnic, cultural, religious, socioeconomic, sexual preferences and/or identities, gender identities/expression, and political backgrounds.
* Must demonstrate ability to navigate crisis and solving problems independently, using best judgment and critical thinking skills.
* Must maintain a positive, friendly, and welcoming attitude with staff and clients at all LBH facilities and within the organization.

* Must pass extensive background check.
* Must have availability to work program specific hours or as defined by leadership.

* Required Education: High School Diploma; Bachelor's Degree in Psychology, Social Work or any other major which includes at least 24 semester college units in one or more of the following subject areas: Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Behavioral Sciences, Psychiatric Nursing, preferred.

jobs.title: Business & People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Business & People Operations Manager**

***Build the systems. Raise the standard. Help great people do great work.***

Explorer Chick is entering its next chapter, and we’re looking for the person who will help define how our people and internal operations grow with it.

We operate more than 30 women’s adventure tours across the U.S. and around the world. Our guests hike mountains, paddle coastlines, rappel waterfalls, trek iconic trails, and take on adventures they may never have imagined themselves doing.

Those adventures happen in the field. But they are made possible by the work behind the scenes.

The guide who knows exactly what good looks like. The manager who has a clear process when something goes wrong. The training that prepares people for the hard moment, not just the easy one. The certification that is current before anyone has to chase it. The payroll input that is right the first time. The policy that is practical, understood, and consistently applied. The infrastructure that helps a small company operate like a great one.

We’re looking for an experienced business and people operations leader with strong HR judgment, high standards, operational discipline, and a genuine respect for the people doing the work.

Think practical HR meets field operations. Not corporate process for process’s sake. The kind of process that is lightweight and useful..

This is a hands-on management role. You’ll lead the guide department, manage the Guide Coordinator, execute day-to-day people operations across the company, and partner closely with the Head of Operations and other Leaders.

And then there’s the other side of the job:

Does it work?

One hour you might be coaching a guide through a difficult guest interaction. The next, you’re tightening an onboarding workflow, reviewing a policy, or solving a missing certification before a departure. Then a sensitive employee issue lands in your inbox. You know what you can resolve, what needs documentation, and what must be escalated.

**What You’ll Own**

**Lead the guide department.** Set expectations, coach performance, build trust, hold standards, and make sure our guides know what excellent looks like before they are asked to deliver it in the field.

**Manage and develop the department Coordinator.** Create clear ownership, priorities, and rhythms for guide administration, scheduling support, certifications, files, onboarding logistics, travel details, gear, receipts, and payroll inputs.

**Run day-to-day people operations.** Own the practical employee lifecycle, including recruiting support, onboarding, documentation, policy rollout, manager support, performance processes, employee relations, and offboarding.

**Build standards and training.** Turn tribal knowledge into clear playbooks, role expectations, training plans, and repeatable systems that make quality easier to deliver across a distributed team.

**Strengthen team member capability.** Give team members tools, coaching, and structure for feedback, documentation, development, accountability, and hard conversations. Step in when the situation requires deeper HR judgment.

**Own guide performance and accountability.** Gather input from Destination Managers and other partners, identify patterns, coach improvement, document concerns, and move discipline forward within the company’s escalation process.

**Plan the guide workforce.** Translate the tour calendar into hiring, readiness, staffing, and development needs. Help the company build the right bench before demand becomes an emergency.

**Create reliable people data and records.** Maintain confidential, accurate systems for personnel files, agreements, certifications, training completion, performance documentation, and other required records.

**Streamline guide operations.** Find the handoffs, duplicate work, missing owners, and recurring fire drills. Design practical workflows that make the guide experience smoother and the business easier to run.

**Protect payroll and finance handoffs.** Ensure guide days, rates, allowances, reimbursements, and other payroll inputs are complete, supported, and delivered on time to Operations and Finance.

**Partner across Product and Operations.** Work laterally with Destination Managers on guide feedback and HR processes while respecting that they report to the Director of Travel Product & Guest Experience. Resolve cross-functional issues with the Head of Operations when ownership or priorities conflict.

**Stay close to the work.** You will inherit processes that are still being built. You should be comfortable doing the work, documenting it, improving it, and then creating the structure that allows others to own the right pieces.

**You Might Be Our Person If...**

You’ve led people in the real world. You know that good management is not simply being supportive. It is setting clear expectations, noticing patterns, giving direct feedback, documenting what matters, and following through.

You have practical HR range. Hiring, onboarding, policies, training, performance management, employee relations, investigations, documentation, leave questions, and compliance are familiar territory. You do not need to be the final authority on every issue, but you know how to assess risk and when to escalate.

You can turn ambiguity into a process people will actually use.

You can write a policy without making it sound like it was written by a robot. You can build a training that changes behavior instead of simply checking a box.

You’re comfortable with seasonal, remote, field-based, or hospitality teams. You understand that the people closest to the guest often work far from headquarters, make decisions in real time, and need both trust and standards.

You don’t avoid hard conversations. You prepare for them, handle them respectfully, and make the next step clear.

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers.

The Pursuit & Channel Operations Manager, Public Sector maintains partners and contracting infrastructure and helps Account Executives use it effectively to secure wins. The role provides specialized execution capacity across longer-term opportunity identification, research and development, prime and partner outreach, teaming development, and day-to-day partner-channel operations.

The role combines public-sector pursuit support with disciplined channel administration. It develops actionable intelligence, recommends contracting and teaming approaches, coordinates required agreements and documentation, and identifies opportunities 12–24 months ahead so Account Executives can focus on mature, near-term pursuits.

### **Essential Key Responsibilities**

* Support larger pursuits as part of Account Executive-led deal teams by challenging assumptions, bringing relevant intelligence forward, identifying competitive vulnerabilities, and recommending actions.
* Research contracts and acquisition approaches; assess incumbents, contract vehicles, timing, and buying patterns; and recommend vehicle, prime/subcontractor, and teaming options for specific pursuits.
* Identify and engage prime contractors and partners for deal-specific teaming, and contact contracting officers and agency contacts to gather information and advance pursuits.
* Prepare, route, and track nondisclosure agreements, contractor teaming arrangements, teaming agreements, and related documentation; coordinate with value-added resellers, resellers, and distributors supporting Account Executives.
* Manage day-to-day channel and partner operations, including partner nondisclosure agreements, market-development-fund contracts, onboarding, and distribution documentation; maintain a current roster of partner contacts and regular working relationships.
* Keep partners carrying D&B General Services Administration SKUs current on offerings, pricing, and pending modifications.

  Partner with the Alliance Manager, Legal, Contracts, Pricing, and Sales to keep channel activity moving and escalate issues early.
* Use government contract-data and market-intelligence tools to identify and qualify opportunities beyond published solicitations, including opportunities 12–24 months from anticipated procurement.
* Respond to research requests from Sales teams by delivering concise, actionable findings and recommendations.
* Enter and maintain longer-term opportunities on behalf of the team, then transition ownership to the appropriate Account Executive as the pursuit matures.

### **Essential Skills and/or Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in public-sector business development, pursuit support, channel operations, government contracting, capture support, or sales operations.
* Working knowledge of government contracting and federal procurement processes.
* Familiarity with federal contract vehicles, teaming arrangements, and third-party government contracting tools and resources.
* Experience supporting capture, business development, pursuit, or government contracting activities.
* Strong partner and stakeholder communication skills, including comfort engaging with teaming artners, prime contractors, contracting officers, and agency contacts.
* Strong organizational and administrative skills, with attention to detail in trackers, contracting documentation, partner records, and follow-through.
* Ability to conduct structured research, synthesize information from multiple sources, and develop concise, actionable recommendations.
* Ability to contribute informed perspectives and recommendations to capture and deal teams.
* Strong prioritization and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing requests and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite skills.
* Show an ownership mindset, be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
* Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
* Fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

### **Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit, speak and operate telephone and/or computer for long periods of time
* Ability to handle pressure, stressful conditions, and conflict resolution
* Ability to work day, evening and/or weekend hours as needed

Bonus eligible

* Up to 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave after one year of employment.

* Do Good Program: Paid volunteer days & donation matching.

* Competitive 401k with company matching.

* Health & wellness benefits, including discounted Wellhub membership rates.

* Medical, dental & vision insurance for you, spouse/partner & dependents.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations (Remote)
jobs.description:
The **Program Manager of Operations (Cross-Zone Execution)** is a strategic operator on the Cross-Zone Execution team in Operations, which builds the metrics, review forums, playbooks, and engagements that help owners across Aledade deliver on company strategy. Aledade’s work sits in four zones (Performance, Transformation, Incubation, and Foundational), and every department has work in every zone. This role helps owners see how their work is performing, diagnose why a metric is off (“Heart of the Problem”), and decide what to do about it, while the accountable owner stays accountable. The role partners directly with senior leaders and helps build the operating infrastructure of a team that is still being designed. It starts in either metrics and forums or engagements and delivery, and works across both as the team matures.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the U.S. or from our office in Bethesda, MD.

### **Primary Duties:**

* Owns the metric record for each metric in scope, including its definition, owner, source system, target, and review forum, and reconciles definition and gross-versus-net differences before they reach a forum. Keeps the executive dashboard current and accurate, using AI tools to automate status collection and draft pre-reads. Leads the mechanics of review forums, including pre-reads, agendas, decisions, and actions, and tracks actions to closure. Spots variance early and routes it to the metric owner and the Director with a clear recommendation.
* Leads short engagements for owners who ask for help: gathers data, frames the root of the problem (or “Heart of the Problem”), tests competing explanations, writes a one-page scope with an exit date, and drafts recommendations for handoff to the accountable business owner. Tracks funded investments against milestones and flags slippage before the forum. When approved, leads end-to-end projects through plan, dependencies, and readiness to a planned handoff.
* Builds and refines the team’s templates, playbooks, and standards, including Aledade's decision making framework, the meeting standard, and “Heart of the Problem” worksheets. Delivers clinics and onboarding for requesters, coaches colleagues, collects feedback and improves the materials.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
* Alternatively, a Master's degree with 6 years of related experience.
* Ability to travel 10-25% of the time

### **Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:**

* Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders
* Structured problem-solving: able to separate competing explanations and say what evidence would tell them apart
* Comfort with data: working in spreadsheets and BI tools, and spotting definition and data errors
* Curiosity and practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day operating work
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders
* Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes

### **Physical Requirements:**

* Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Remote

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Finance

  

fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

**About this role:**
--------------------

We're hiring an Accounting Operations Manager to own the operational core of fal's finance function: payables, spend management, procurement, and the books of our subsidiaries. You will work in Pacific Standard Time zone, run the weekly cadence that keeps vendors paid and spend under control, and you will turn the processes behind it into documented, audit-ready controls as fal completes its first financial statement audit and moves to a new ERP.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building processes as much as running it.

### **What you’ll do**

### **Spend management and AP oversight**

* Own Ramp administration and allocate and oversee workload carried by offshore supporting AP team
* Act as the first point of contact for employee and vendor questions on spend, declined transactions, and payment status.
* Review card transactions and reimbursements for policy compliance, receipt support, GL coding, and accrual cut-off, and follow up on exceptions until they close.

* Run the weekly payables cycle end to end: invoice intake, matching to PO and receipt, GL and department coding, and approval routing.
* Maintain the vendor master, including W-9 collection, bank-detail changes verified by call-back, and controls against payment fraud.
* Prepare the weekly payment batch with a cash-requirements summary for finance leadership approval.

### **Procurement and purchase orders**

* Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Ops on scalable procurement processes, including approval thresholds by amount, department, and vendor risk.
* Partner with Legal and budget owners so contracts, POs, and invoices tie out before payment.

**Subsidiary accounting and intercompany**

* Keep the books for fal's subsidiaries under US GAAP, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and monthly close.
* Record, settle, and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances each month.
* Prepare elimination entries and support consolidation of entity financials.
* Bring acquired entities onto fal's chart of accounts, close calendar, and control environment.

### **Audit readiness and systems**

* Document process narratives and controls for AP, treasury, and procurement, and prepare the evidence auditors request.
* Help configure AP, procurement, and intercompany workflows in fal's new ERP.
* Use AI tools and automation to remove manual steps from invoice processing, coding, and reconciliations.

### **1099 reporting, tax and close support**

* Own 1099 readiness year-round: vendor classification, TIN matching, and complete W-9 and W-8 files.
* Prepare, review, and approve annual 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC filings, and handle corrections and IRS notices.
* Support Tax function on ad hoc basis, including sales and use tax, and property tax.
* Support the month end close process, including but not limited to reconciliations of prepaids, deposits, payables, accruals.

### **Qualifications/Nice-to-haves**

* 5+ years in accounting operations, accounts payable, or general accounting
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
* Hands-on experience running AP and spend management in Ramp, Brex, or Bill.com, integrated with an ERP.
* Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, month-end close, and balance sheet reconciliations.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Practice Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPY HEALTH & NUTRITION

Happy Health & Nutrition (HHN) is a growing, founder-led virtual nutrition practice helping adults improve metabolic health and build sustainable habits through evidence-based nutrition care and structured coaching.

Most of our care is currently insurance-based. We are also developing cash-pay programs to serve clients whose needs, goals, or coverage may not fit our insurance-based services.

We believe excellent care depends on excellent operations. Clients should feel welcomed and supported, our team should know who owns each next step, and our referring partners should experience a practice they can trust.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for an experienced private-practice operations leader to help HHN strengthen its operating foundation and prepare for its next stage of growth.

This person will work closely with the founder to identify gaps, understand what is causing them, and lead practical improvements. The work will support a better client experience, stronger follow-through and retention, and reliable systems for managing new inquiries and appropriate client enrollment.

We’re looking for someone with substantial senior-level experience operating a private healthcare or clinical practice and a demonstrated record of helping a practice scale. We value evidence of what you have built and improved over a particular number of years.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can see the larger system, make sound decisions, and help a team follow through. It is not a general assistant position.

WHAT YOU’LL LEAD

* Assess HHN’s workflows and identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, missed handoffs, delays, and unclear ownership.

* Improve the client journey from inquiry and intake through scheduling, ongoing care, follow-up, retention, and transitions.

* Strengthen the systems that help HHN respond to prospective clients, coordinate referrals, and support appropriate enrollment.

* Build and maintain clear workflows, standard operating procedures, handoffs, and team reference materials.

* Create a practical operating rhythm for priorities, owners, deadlines, follow-up, and completion.

* Help the founder turn strategic priorities into sequenced projects with clear accountability.

* Establish useful operational measures for response time, intake completion, first-visit follow-through, retention, capacity, and referral activity.

* Improve how the team uses its CRM and practice systems, including Zoho CRM, SimplePractice, Spruce, and Microsoft Teams/other tools.

* Clarify responsibilities and escalation paths so work is distributed appropriately and the founder or one team member is not the default owner of every open task.

* Support hiring, onboarding, role clarity, and management routines as HHN grows.

* Coordinate with external billing, technology, and other practice partners; track issues and route decisions to the appropriate person.

* Surface recurring client or team concerns, look for root causes, and lead practical solutions.

Clinical judgment, nutrition care, and medical advice remain with HHN’s clinical team. The Operations Manager supports the systems around care and does not make clinical decisions.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

* Senior-level experience operating a private healthcare or clinical practice.

* Demonstrated experience helping a private practice grow, with specific examples of what you personally owned and what improved.

* Experience diagnosing operational problems and implementing solutions that improved service, client retention, capacity, or growth.

* Strong project-management and follow-through skills.

* The judgment to distinguish a process problem from a staffing, capacity, or priority problem.

* Clear, direct, and respectful communication with a founder and a distributed team.

* Comfort building systems that are useful and sustainable, rather than adding process for its own sake.

* Experience with CRMs, practice-management systems, shared documents, and operational reporting.

* A commitment to confidentiality and appropriate handling of client information.

EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE ESPECIALLY HELPFUL

* Nutrition, dietetics, behavioral health, or another virtual private-practice setting.

* Insurance-based services as well as cash-pay services or programs.

* Referral-partner workflows and healthcare billing or revenue-cycle coordination.

* Leading a practice through meaningful growth or a change in its service model.

HOW WE’LL DEFINE EARLY SUCCESS

During the first 90 days, we expect to develop a shared view of HHN’s key workflows and bottlenecks, clarify ownership of priority operational work, improve or document the most important processes, and establish a realistic operating plan the team can maintain. Specific measures will be agreed upon after an initial assessment.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your résumé and a brief response to these questions:

1. What private practice have you helped operate, and what responsibilities did you personally own?

2. Describe a practice you helped scale. What changed in its size, capacity, services, or operating systems?

3. Tell us about an operational problem you identified, how you investigated it, what you changed, and what result followed.

4. What would you want to understand about HHN before recommending operational changes?

Please begin your application with “**Practice Operations Leader.**” Specific examples are more helpful than a high volume of applications.

Experience:

* Senior Operations management: 3 years (Required)
* Private Healthcare or Clinical Practice. : 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

At Carr, Riggs & Ingram, your career path is just that—yours. We are strong believers in the notion that your career should adapt to and integrate into your life and not the other way around. We invite you to explore our opportunities and learn how CRI can help you reinvent your career path and shape your future.

We are dedicated to uniting your professional passions with your individual personal pursuits, creating an empowered workplace for everyone—from interns and admins to staff accountants and future partners. At CRI, #EverybodyCounts.

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with 7+ years of project management experience, preferably leading IT migrations, M&A integrations, business transitions, or other complex cross-functional initiatives.

This role is responsible for managing projects from initial planning through implementation and stabilization. The Project Manager will coordinate teams across IT, Finance, HR, Security, Marketing, Legal, and other business functions to ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and with minimal disruption to the business.

### **Essential Functions:**

**Project Management**

* Lead complex projects from initiation and planning through implementation, stabilization, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Coordinate multiple workstreams and ensure owners understand responsibilities and deadlines.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify delays, dependencies, resource constraints, and competing priorities.
* Maintain project documentation, including status reports, decision logs, action-item trackers, risk registers, and implementation plans.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining visibility into priorities, risks, and deadlines.

**IT Migration & Integration**

* Coordinate system migrations, data conversions, software deployments, access provisioning, testing, training, and go-live activities.
* Partner with IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors to define requirements and implementation plans.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), issue resolution, deployment readiness, and post-implementation support.
* Manage implementation cutover plans and track readiness leading up to go-live.

**M&A Integration**

* Support integration activities following mergers, acquisitions, affiliations, or other business combinations.
* Coordinate Day 1 readiness and post-close integration activities.
* Track integration milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and outstanding action items.
* Work closely with acquired organizations and internal functional leaders to transition systems, processes, employees, and operations.

### **Qualifications:**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of project management experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing IT implementations, system integrations, M&A integrations, or business transformation projects.
* Experience managing projects with multiple workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholder groups.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies and project governance.
* Experience developing and managing project plans, risk registers, issue logs, action-item trackers, and executive status reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Experience managing M&A integration projects, including Day 1 readiness and post-close integration.
* Experience working in a professional services, accounting, consulting, financial services, or similarly complex environment.
* Experience with enterprise software implementations, system migrations, and data conversions.

***Applicants m******ust be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. CRI will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this position or future positions (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa).***

CRI is a nationally recognized accounting and advisory firm known for its audit, tax, and business consulting expertise. The profession and our communities widely acknowledge our commitment to delivering tailored solutions to help ensure client success.

  

We stand out through our collaborative, client-focused approach, offering personalized services backed by deep industry knowledge. Clients trust CRI as a dedicated partner who understands their unique needs and ensures support at every step. To learn more about the industries we serve, our service offerings, and our family of companies please visit us at www.criadv.com.

  

CRI offers a generous benefits package that includes 21 PTO days, 9 paid holidays, and company-paid long-term disability and life insurance. Employees also have access to Blue Cross Blue Shield medical insurance, as well as dental, vision, and short-term disability coverage. Additional benefits include parental leave, flexible spending accounts, and a 401(k) retirement plan.

This role is for US candidates only.

FULL TIME - REMOTE - 4 DAY WORK WEEK!

Consultwebs helps law firms grow through digital marketing, and we’re looking for a Project Manager to keep our client campaigns running smoothly. You’ll manage campaigns across SEO, PPC, link building and outreach, content marketing, social media, and video. Your job is to make sure the work gets done on time, stays within budget, and helps each firm reach its goals. You’ll work closely with our marketing managers and specialists, writers, video editors, and the creative team, and you’ll be their main point of contact. You’ll also join client calls on Zoom when needed. This role is a great fit if you’ve managed several client projects at once at an agency and you know how SEO, paid search, and content work together.

 **Compensation:**

$50,000 - $55,000

 **Responsibilities:**

**What You’ll Do**

**Project and task management**

* Build and update campaign roadmaps and monthly client reports with our Client Services team.
* Lead planning and execution of SEO campaigns, and oversee video, PPC, and social media deliverables so they match the agreed scope, timeline, and goals.
* Create, assign, and track tasks in our project management software.
* Keep projects on schedule by spotting bottlenecks early and adjusting workflows when priorities shift.
* Run campaign kickoffs, daily stand-ups, and status meetings so everyone knows what’s next.

**Resource and budget management**

* Assign work based on team capacity and what each campaign needs.
* Track project budgets, including labor hours and outside vendor costs.
* Keep campaigns within budget while still delivering results for the client.

**Team coordination and leadership**

* Be the go-to contact connecting Client Services, SEO, Paid Search, Social Media, Link Building and Outreach, Video, Content, and Creative/Production.
* Give teams clear direction on timelines, budgets, tasks, and client goals.
* Help build a team culture where people take ownership, communicate early, and keep learning.

**Risk management and quality control**

* Flag campaign risks early and work with the right people to fix them before they affect the client.
* Review deliverables to make sure they meet our quality standards and support the campaign strategy.

**Process improvement**

* Work with our Lead Operations Project Manager to improve workflows and tools, and help standardize how teams deliver work.

 **Qualifications:**

### **Qualifications**

* 3+ years of project management experience, preferably in a digital marketing or advertising agency.
* Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing campaigns (SEO, Paid, Video, Social, and Content).
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality campaigns under tight timelines within budget.
* Proficiency in project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, or Teamwork.
* Exceptional organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Experience managing budgets, forecasting resources, and prioritizing tasks across simultaneous projects.
* Highly proactive with strong critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

 **About Company**

Consultwebs exists to help people find law firms online. We do this by providing innovative and comprehensive marketing for clients by focusing on their ROI as our main metric of success. We also seek to develop our team to be the very best so that we can provide the very best service and products to clients.

A part of being the best is fostering a good company culture. Everyone at Consultwebs is expected to live out the following core values.

* **Integrity, Always**
* **Have Passion**
* **Work as One Team, Serve as One Team**
* **Embrace and Drive Change**
* **Check your Ego**
* **Own your Results**
* **Communicate Intentionally**

Consultwebs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We believe that unique perspectives power great innovation, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We want to ensure our recruitment process is accessible to everyone.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Account & Project Manager
jobs.description:
E-Commerce Account & Project Manager

**Company:** In The Black Advisory  
**Location:** Remote – United States  
**Job Type:** Part-time, with potential to transition to full-time  
**Compensation:** $25–$40 per hour, depending on experience  
**Expected Hours:** 20–30 hours per week

About Us

In The Black Advisory partners with emerging and established consumer brands to launch, manage and scale their businesses across e-commerce, marketplaces and traditional retail. Our services include strategic consulting, marketplace management, retail expansion, fulfillment and logistics.

We are a growing, entrepreneurial company looking for someone who wants to take ownership, help build the business and grow with us.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced E-Commerce Account & Project Manager to manage client accounts, oversee projects and drive execution across multiple sales channels, including Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Costco and other retail partners.

This is a hands-on role that combines client management, project management and e-commerce execution. You will work directly with company leadership, clients, our warehouse operations team and external partners.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, resourceful and comfortable working independently. We are looking for someone who can own projects from start to finish, anticipate challenges and ensure deliverables are completed without constant oversight.

Key Responsibilities

* Own day-to-day client account management and communication.
* Manage client onboarding, product launches and ongoing initiatives.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines and deliverables.
* Manage Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Seller Center and Shopify accounts.
* Manage product listings, catalogs, SKU data and account maintenance.
* Coordinate new marketplace and retail channel launches.
* Monitor sales performance, account health and marketplace issues.
* Coordinate inventory availability, fulfillment and system integrations with our warehouse operations team.
* Manage external vendors, advertising partners and service providers.
* Prepare client reporting, meeting agendas and status updates.
* Identify issues, recommend solutions and drive resolution.
* Develop and document processes to support business growth.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of two years of relevant e-commerce, marketplace, account management or project management experience.
* Hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Seller Center and Shopify.
* Experience managing multiple clients, brands or projects simultaneously.
* Strong project management, organizational and prioritization skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
* Availability during standard U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with consumer product brands or e-commerce agencies.
* Experience launching brands and products across multiple sales channels.
* Experience with wholesale, retail onboarding, EDI and drop-ship programs.
* Familiarity with inventory management, warehouse management systems and 3PL integrations.
* Experience coordinating digital advertising and retail media partners.
* Experience with Airtable or similar project management tools.

What We're Looking For

* Someone who takes ownership and follows through.
* Someone who communicates proactively and brings solutions, not just problems.
* Someone who is comfortable moving between client communication, project management and hands-on execution.
* Someone who thrives in a small, fast-moving business without layers of management.
* Someone interested in a long-term opportunity with increasing responsibility as the business grows.

This position will initially be 20–30 hours per week, with the opportunity to transition to full-time as our client portfolio expands.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief overview of your experience managing e-commerce accounts, client relationships and multichannel projects.

In your application, please include the e-commerce platforms you have independently managed, your hourly compensation expectations and your availability to start.

Pay: $35.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
