### **About Us**

Accelerate Cloud Solutions (ACS) is customer obsessed; we don’t just build to spec. We fully engage with our ‘client partners’ to learn their business, understand what makes them unique (or help to create that), and to get to know the people and their goals. We start every project with ‘what does success look like’ when we get to key milestones or delivery in full – and this is different for every client. In some cases, we help them think through this and define it – many have not really gotten down to that level. It is not about being ‘done’, but rather about achieving our mutual goals.

ACS is powered by exceptional employees in every role. We have created an environment where everyone has a voice, and we each learn from others every day. No two employees are alike, just as no two client experiences are exactly the same – and we value and seek that diversity. We are problem solvers who seek to understand the environments of our client partners, and work alongside them to engage in new ways, and deliver beyond expectation. We build relationships in our teams, our clients, and our communities, giving back wherever we can in order to build stronger relationships and outcomes. Plan, build, deliver, celebrate, repeat…

In partnership with our clients, we are focused on exceptional delivery and dedication to every step along the way. Whether engaged in a solution design discussion, delivering a phenomenal ‘go live’ experience, or continuing to manage the customer environment to operate at its best, we do it all as a team. And we build loyalty and ongoing business with our client partners. From sales to delivery, our actions are seamless and we live by the ‘one team’ approach.

We are ***Accelerators***.

### **About You**

You are passionate about customers and focused on doing the right thing in every case. You are driven to learn and expand your skills and bring your teammates along with you by sharing your knowledge and experience. Being creative and thinking through options is second nature to you, and you take the time to understand the customer and their goals – and not just deliver tasks. When the team wins, we all win – and there is no better place to be. You thrive in this type of environment.

If this sounds like you, then please keep reading…and join us to become an ***Accelerator***!

* **Be a trusted partner.** Build relationships and partnerships with business sponsors and other key stakeholders to meet organizational objectives, manage expectations, and communicate on progress. Skillfully manage competing priorities and varying audiences.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical ideas, whether to other technical peers or non-technical team members or customers.
* Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment, setting priorities, and planning.
* Ability to develop strong interdepartmental and cross-functional working relationships within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken, in conveying/understanding complex concepts both to/from the technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience managing complex technical projects at enterprise scale.
* Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.
* Passionate about being a team player, motivating people, ensuring accountability (self- and team) and achieving exceptional results.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Salesforce certification (admin or consultant series)
* 5+ years of experience as a project manager driving delivery of complex technical solutions, preferably in the Salesforce ecosystem. (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ ideally)
* Experience with Agile Scrum methodology

All roles are currently remote and US-based; some travel will be required based on customer or company need. We are not creating Road Warriors, and it is a new world where remote is often favored by our clients.

### **Job Type**

jobs.description:
**Why RF Technologies?**

At RF Technologies, your work has a purpose to Empower a Safer World. We design and build life-saving technology that protects newborns in hospital nurseries, helps keep seniors safe from falls, and gives nurses and caregivers a way to call for help when they need it most. Every system you deliver helps protect people when it matters.

Since 1987, we have been pioneers in healthcare and senior living safety, with more than 10,000 installations nationwide. Today we are a close-knit team of problem solvers who never stop exploring new ways to advance safety technology. Build a career where you can see the impact of your work every day.

**Position Summary**

As a Senior Project Manager at RF Technologies, you will own our largest and most complex enterprise system projects from the first quote through installation and go-live. You are a confident, credible leader who builds trust with customer executives, runs the room in every meeting, and leads cross-functional teams through influence. You will have the independence to lead your projects, drive innovation, and deliver on our commitments to our customers on time, on budget, and true to their specifications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Project Ownership & Leadership**

* Own large, complex enterprise projects from quote through install, go-live, and final signoff, serving as the single accountable leader for every outcome.
* Lead project planning, budgeting, and resource identification, and anticipate risks before they become problems.
* Build and lead cross-functional project teams, set clear objectives, assign individual responsibilities, and hold team members accountable for delivering.
* Develop project work plans and revise them quickly when needs change.
* Make sound decisions under pressure, work through roadblocks and setbacks with a positive mentality, and project confidence that steadies the team and the customer.

### **Stakeholder Management & Executive Presence**

* Serve as the trusted advisor to customer executives and project sponsors, building strong relationships from kickoff through go-live.
* Run the room: lead kickoff, planning, status, and escalation meetings with confidence, set the agenda, drive decisions, and keep diverse groups aligned.
* Communicate proactively on progress, schedule, and issues, and represent the Company in meetings with the customer at every level.
* Negotiate competing priorities, resolve conflict, and escalate early and constructively when needed.
* Partner with sales to manage change orders and protect project scope and margin.

### **Scope, Site Surveys & Commissioning**

* Perform site surveys, coordinate quotes and configuration, and shape the scope of each project.
* Lead commissioning of the system with Service and drive it through to final signoff.

### **Installation Oversight & Compliance**

* Direct and coordinate all consultants, contractors, sub-contractors, and laborers on the project, and hold each accountable for their commitments.
* Monitor work in progress to confirm teams follow the drawings and meet all specifications and regulations, and address any gaps right away.
* Take responsibility for securing all necessary permits and licenses.

### **Schedule, Budget & Risk Control**

* Track and control the installation schedule and associated costs, and drive every project to completion on time and under budget.
* Share best practices and informally coach other project managers to raise the standard of project delivery across the team.

**Qualifications**
------------------

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 7+ years of installation project management experience, including leading large, multi-site enterprise projects of increasing complexity. Experience in fiber optics, construction, or a related industry.
* Proven stakeholder management skills, including a track record of building trusted relationships with customer executives and sponsors.
* Strong executive presence and high personal confidence, with the ability to run a room, lead difficult conversations, and drive decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to plan, organize, and lead a team effort through influence.
* Ability to work under pressure and coordinate numerous activities and groups of people who need to cooperate to achieve maximum efficiency.
* Excellent computer skills and experience with Microsoft 365.
* Experience using project management tools such as Monday.com.
* Ability to travel up to 30% as needed.

### **Preferred**

* Low-voltage systems experience.

Pay range: Annual salary between **$90,000-$100,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and skills. This position is eligible for all benefits including healthcare insurance, 401(k), PTO and Paid Holidays.

Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

* Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio’s largest customers don’t need a standard onboarding checklist; they need a trusted partner who can make a complex change feel manageable. As an Implementation Manager, you’ll lead a focused portfolio of Key and Enterprise customers through launches that can span teams, locations, data, and connected systems. You’ll shape the plan with customer leaders, help teams make sound rollout decisions, and see the impact as Fleetio becomes part of how their operations run. You’ll also help strengthen the way Fleetio delivers its most complex implementations.

This is a senior, customer-facing individual-contributor role. You’ll lead through project ownership and influence, partnering with customer executives and operators and with Fleetio teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead a focused portfolio of complex Enterprise implementations from post-sale handoff through launch and stabilization. Build a trusted partnership, understand what success means in the customer’s operation, and shape a rollout plan that fits the real-world need, not just the software setup.
* Bring the moving parts together. Turn discovery into a clear path forward, coordinating customer and Fleetio owners across workflows, data, configuration, integrations, testing, and rollout. Keep scope, responsibilities, and dependencies clear and documented, and bring in technical partners where needed.
* Make complexity manageable. Use pilots, phased rollouts, and readiness checkpoints to reduce risk; keep customer project leads and executives aligned; and surface risks or changed assumptions early with a practical recommendation.
* Set customers up to sustain the change. Make role-based training and adoption part of the plan, lead a thoughtful transition to Customer Success, and turn lessons from complex launches into better ways of working across Fleetio.

### **Your Experience**

* 5+ years in customer-facing SaaS implementation, enterprise onboarding, technical project delivery, or a related role, with direct ownership of complex implementations through launch.
* Experience guiding enterprise customers through multi-stakeholder, multi-location, or work-stream deployments.
* Strong project leadership: you can turn customer goals into a workable plan, coordinate parallel work-streams and dependencies, and reset expectations when conditions change.
* Clear, confident communication with customer operators, IT teams, project leads, and executives, including leading discovery, facilitating decisions, and navigating difficult conversations.
* Technical aptitude with data-heavy implementations, including migration, configuration, integrations, testing, and cutover. You know when to involve technical specialists and how to keep customer expectations grounded in confirmed scope.

### **Helpful Experience**

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

LIVunLtd designs, equips, installs, and supports premier fitness and wellness amenities for leading property owners and developers nationwide. As our Consulting & Development division expands, we are seeking a detail-oriented **Project Manager** to scale our end-to-end project delivery—from signed proposals through final closeout.

In this role, you will collaborate with an established team of sales, design, and operations professionals to coordinate projects, vendors, and clients while leveraging modern AI tools to enhance speed and precision. This position offers a clear trajectory for advancement into senior project management or operations leadership as the division grows.

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Proposals & Quoting**

* Partner with design and sales teams to craft precise cost estimates and comprehensive proposal packages.
* Track supplier pricing structures, product availability, and lead times.
* Assist with ongoing client outreach to advance active sales opportunities.
* Convert approved client proposals into purchase orders, agreements, and execution plans.

**Project Kickoff & Handoff**

* Direct internal and external launch sessions to confirm project scope, specifications, timelines, and financial parameters before issuing orders.
* Serve as the primary central contact connecting design & sales.

**Installation Management**

* Oversight of delivery timelines from initial order placement through final punch list resolution.
* Direct operational logistics involving equipment suppliers, freight handlers, installers, site contractors, and property managers.
* Perform field walkthroughs to supervise implementation and resolve site challenges efficiently.
* Provide clients with regular, transparent project updates throughout execution.

**Financial Coordination**

* Administer purchasing documents, billing schedules, and completion records to facilitate prompt invoicing.
* Monitor project spend against established budgets and manage scope adjustments to manage change orders to keep projects on budget.

**Compliance & Administration**

* Handle certificates of insurance, vendor qualification, and site entry clearances.
* Ensure accurate data maintenance across corporate CRM and project management software.

**Closeout & Service Transition**

* Assemble specification sheets and submittal documents for distribution to clients, architectural partners, and general contractors.
* Gather closeout documentation, register product warranties, and schedule operational orientation for clients.
* Transition finished projects seamlessly to the service team to support long-term service contracts.

**AI & Systems Optimization**

* Leverage AI solutions to streamline quoting procedures, project tracking, recordkeeping, and operational reporting.
* Develop standard operating procedures and operational playbooks to enable divisional growth.

**Cross-Functional Support**

* Collaborate with fitness operations and amenity management teams on special projects as assigned.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:** 2–4 years of project coordination or project management experience in commercial construction, FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment), equipment installation, or a related field.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with AI tools and a strong drive to build process automations; proficiency in spreadsheets, CRM platforms, and project management software.
* **Organizational Skills:** Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, competing priorities, and strict deadlines.
* **Communication:** Clear, polished, and professional communication skills when engaging with clients, vendors, and contractors.
* **Travel:** Willingness and ability to travel regularly to project sites (approx. 25%).
* **Preferred:** Prior experience within the fitness, wellness, or hospitality industries.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time and on-budget project delivery.
* Turnaround speed and accuracy for quotes and proposals.
* Promptness of billing submissions at project closeout.
* Client satisfaction and seamless transitions to service agreements.
* Quality and adoption of documented processes and automated workflows.

**Why Join LIVunLtd?**

* **Career Growth:** Clear path to advance into a senior project management or operations leadership role as the division expands.
* **High-Impact Portfolio:** Opportunity to manage Class A commercial and Fortune 500 projects across the country.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Work alongside experienced professionals across sales, design, and client services within a growing national industry leader.

Compensation: This role offers a competitive salary of $85,000-$90,000 + a 10% bonus opportunity.

**Position Summary:**
=====================

  
National OnDemand is a telecommunications construction general contractor delivering fiber optic and outside plant (OSP) infrastructure programs nationwide. We are staffing a multi-year, large-scale project to install and test fiber optic and structured cabling infrastructure inside an AI data center campus in Louisiana. NATIONAL ONDEMAND is executing this scope as a construction partner to the general contractor leading the site program, and this role owns NATIONAL ONDEMAND's execution from mobilization through final acceptance and turnover.  
  
The Data Center Project Coordinator provides administrative, logistical, and deployment support for National OnDemand’s data center program. The position coordinates technician mobilization, travel, lodging, workforce schedules, training and compliance documentation, and daily administrative activities needed to support Corning project work. The role serves as a central coordination point among the Program Management Office, Project Management, Human Resources, Recruiting, Payroll, field leadership, technicians, and other internal partners.  
  
  

**Primary Position Duties:**
============================

* **Technician Deployment and Mobilization**
* Coordinate the deployment and mobilization of Data Center Technicians and Technician Leads to assigned project locations.
* Maintain current deployment rosters that identify employee assignments, positions, rotations, mobilization dates, shifts, and status.
* Confirm that employees complete required onboarding, training, documentation, and project-specific requirements before deployment.
* Track upcoming mobilizations, rotations, demobilizations, replacements, and staffing gaps, and communicate changes promptly to project leadership and affected employees.
* **Travel, Lodging, and Transportation Coordination**
* Coordinate employee travel arrangements associated with project deployment, training, scheduled rotations, and demobilization.
* Maintain lodging assignments, rooming lists, arrival and departure dates, and related changes.
* Coordinate transportation requirements with project leadership and communicate travel, lodging, and transportation instructions to employees before deployment.
* Escalate material travel or lodging issues to the appropriate leader and document resolution.
* **Scheduling and Workforce Tracking**
* Maintain technician rotation, shift, and deployment schedules and provide timely updates to Project Management.
* Track workforce availability and assist with replacements when employees are unavailable, reassigned, or removed from the project.
* Coordinate relevant schedule information with Human Resources and Payroll to support accurate employee records and timekeeping.
* Maintain current employee contact and emergency information for deployed personnel.
* **Training and Compliance Coordination**
* Track completion of required company, customer, site-specific, safety, technical, and data center training.
* Coordinate attendance for required training and maintain related training and certification records.
* Track background checks, drug screens, site access requirements, and other required deployment documentation.
* Notify appropriate leadership when an employee has not satisfied deployment or access requirements.
* **Administrative and Project Support**
* Maintain organized electronic project files, employee rosters, deployment trackers, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and distribute staffing, deployment, training, lodging, and exception reports as requested.
* Support project meetings by preparing rosters, reports, meeting materials, and action-item trackers.
* Coordinate information among Project Management, Human Resources, Recruiting, Payroll, Safety, Operations, and field leadership.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support successful project execution.

**Position Requirements:**
==========================

* Experience coordinating employee travel, lodging, mobilization, or workforce deployment preferred.
* Strong organizational, written communication, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to prioritize changing business needs, maintain accuracy under time-sensitive conditions, and handle confidential employee and business information.
* Ability to communicate professionally with field employees, supervisors, managers, vendors, and corporate departments.

**Working conditions**

* Work is primarily performed in an office or remote administrative environment with frequent computer, telephone, email, and Microsoft Teams use.

**Physical requirements**

========================

jobs.title: HEDIS & Quality Data Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Fenyx Health is an innovative, fast-growing Medicare Savings Account (MSA) health plan dedicated to transforming healthcare delivery and empowering Medicare beneficiaries. With strong foundational quality work already underway, we are seeking a hands-on, organized operational owner to standardize, strengthen, and manage the HEDIS and quality data operations backbone that drives our CMS Star Ratings and Quality Improvement initiatives.

**Role Overview**

The Lead of HEDIS & Quality Data Operations will play a foundational role in organizing and scaling our health plan’s quality operations as a senior individual contributor. Reporting to the VP of Strategic Partnerships, you will serve as the end-to-end operational owner for HEDIS execution and annual NCQA audits, as well as the operational business owner for CAHPS and HOS survey vendors. Because Fenyx Health operates non-network MSA plans—where members have high-deductible freedom of choice without traditional PCP gatekeeping or Part D coverage—capturing accurate clinical data through non-standard supplemental feeds and medical record retrieval is essential to reflecting true care quality. You will define clear data requirements for internal and contracted IT teams, validate incoming vendor feeds, coordinate HEDIS care gap closure across internal teams and external partners, and maintain ongoing performance forecasting to maximize Star Rating outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End HEDIS Operations, Annual Audit & Survey Vendor Management:**

* Serve as the primary operational owner and main point of contact for external data vendors, certified HEDIS submission partners, vendor technical leads, and CMS-approved CAHPS/HOS survey vendors.
* Establish and manage vendor SLAs, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality control workflows—conducting periodic internal audits of incoming vendor and supplemental data feeds (EHR, clinical, claims, encounters, lab, and registries) to ensure ongoing accuracy and timeliness.
* Manage operational execution and data submission timelines for HEDIS, CAHPS, and HOS (including mock survey administration) to ensure 100% on-time, error-free reporting in partnership with Compliance.
* Own the annual HEDIS audit lifecycle end-to-end—serving as the primary liaison with NCQA-certified auditors and technical leads to validate data completeness, manage HEDIS Roadmap submissions, and complete primary source verification (PSV).

**Technical Specification Mastery, Data Requirements & Supplemental Feeds:**

* Apply deep expertise in NCQA HEDIS technical specifications, CMS Star Ratings Technical Notes, and CAHPS/HOS sampling rules to identify data gaps, logic discrepancies, and missed clinical capture opportunities.
* Define clear business and technical data requirements (specifying required data elements, layouts, and delivery schedules) for internal and contracted IT resources and vendors and perform thorough QA on resulting file outputs and occasional sFTP file transfers.
* Maximize clinical data capture across Fenyx Health’s non-network MSA member population by expanding standard and non-standard supplemental data feeds, EMR/HIE connectivity, and medical record retrieval workflows in strict adherence to NCQA audit standards.

**HEDIS Gap Closure Coordination & Performance Forecasting:**

* Run ongoing predictive performance models and measure-level cut-point forecasting against CMS technical specifications to identify at-risk HEDIS, CAHPS, and HOS measures early.
* Coordinate all operational aspects of HEDIS care gap closure—generating member and provider target gap lists, tracking closure velocity, and collaborating closely with internal outreach teams and external clinical/vendor partners (while internal outreach teams execute direct member calls).
* Monitor intra-year measure performance and mock survey results, building clear operational and executive dashboards to provide real-time visibility into HEDIS and Star Rating trajectories.

**Process Standardization & Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Organize, standardize, and streamline existing quality workflows into documented, repeatable SOPs and data governance routines suited for a fast-growing MSA health plan.
* Partner closely with internal and contracted IT, Clinical Operations, Member Experience, Actuarial, and Compliance teams to ensure seamless data flow, audit readiness, and timely gap closure.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* **Experience:** 3–5+ years of direct experience in Medicare Advantage quality operations, specifically leading HEDIS reporting, NCQA audits, and quality data management (with working knowledge of CAHPS and HOS survey operations).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-related field.
* **Technical Expertise:** Deep, hands-on knowledge of NCQA HEDIS technical specifications, supplemental data validation rules, CMS Star Ratings cut-point methodology, and CAHPS/HOS survey administration and sampling rules.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (CSM)- Billing & RCM Experience
jobs.description:
***Customer Success Manager, Billing and RCM***

**Job Overview**

Opus is a fully integrated EHR, CRM, and RCM platform built for behavioral health, substance use, eating disorder, psychiatry, and psychology practices. Our mission is to transform behavioral health care for 4 million patients by 2028.

**The Role**

Own the rollout of Opus RCM for every customer, from signed contract to a billing team that runs it with confidence. You implement the platform, configure it to the customer's payer mix and levels of care, train and coach their staff, take them live, and stay with them until clean claims are flowing.

This isn't a billing role, but it needs billing chops. You have to speak the language of billers, billing managers, and CFOs to earn their trust, find what's actually going wrong, and teach them to fix it. You teach the customer's team to run their revenue cycle on Opus RCM; you don't run it for them. Practices switch billing systems to fix something specific: claims that keep rejecting, AR aging past 90 days, a billing team fighting its own software. Going live is the means, not the goal. You get the customer to the result they switched for and show them the evidence. You won't do it alone. You work closely with our Customer Success Managers and Implementations team, who implement and train the EHR, with Support, and with our RCM services team.

**Who Thrives Here**

This role suits someone who has billed in behavioral health, run projects, and loves teaching, and who would rather build something than inherit it. The attributes that matter most:

* ***Billing fluency***. You know the revenue cycle well enough to talk shop with any biller or CFO. When a claim rejects, you can tell whether it's configuration, documentation, workflow, or the payer.
* ***Teaching that sticks***. You know adults learn by doing. You build training around the customer's real workflows, check for understanding, and coach until their team can do it without you.
* ***Project discipline***. You run several implementations at once against dates and go-live criteria, and every stakeholder knows what's next and who owns it.
* ***Empathy with boundaries***. You understand the pressure a billing team is under when cash is late, and you stay on their side. You also tell them plainly when a request is out of scope, a delay is on their end, or a workflow isn't supported, without damaging the relationship.
* ***Entrepreneurial spirit***. You build the training materials, checklists, and processes you wish existed, and improve them with every customer.
* ***Curiosity***. The problem a customer reports is often a symptom. You dig until you find the real cause, because only that fix holds.
* ***Persistence***. Open items, stalled enrollments, and half-finished configurations get pursued to closure.

**Responsibilities**

Onboarding & Implementation

* Run multiple concurrent Opus RCM implementations to scope, timeline, and go-live criteria, for new customers and for existing customers moving from another billing platform
* Set up clearinghouse connections and configure payers, fee schedules, and billing rules to each customer's payer mix and levels of care
* Map the customer's billing workflows and close the gaps between intake, clinical documentation, and claims
* Plan the customer's transition off their outgoing billing system so no AR is stranded
* Training & Coaching
* Design and deliver live training for billers, billing managers, and front desk staff, built on the customer's own workflows
* Coach the customer's team on live data after go-live until they run Opus RCM on their own
* Certify customer billing super-users
* Build and maintain the training materials, guides, and recordings the team reuses
* Retrain for staff turnover, new payers, and new features
* Working Across Teams
* Partner with the CSM and Implementations team so the EHR and RCM rollouts run as one plan, with one go-live story for the customer
* Hand off and escalate to Support with the detail needed to resolve issues fast
* Bring in our RCM services team when a customer needs billing work done, not training
* Route product gaps to engineering with clear, specific examples

**Customer Outcomes & Growth**

* Get every customer to a first accepted claim batch fast, then to sustained clean claims
* Run reviews tying Opus RCM to financial outcomes: acceptance rates, denial trends, days in AR
* Spot and source expansion: users, locations, modules, and services
* Flag retention risk early

**KPIs**

KPIs are set each quarter. Measures you can expect to see include:

* Time from RCM go-live to first accepted claim batch
* On-time go-live rate
* Training completion and super-user certification
* Customer billing outcomes: clean claim rate, denial rate, and days in AR at 90 and 180 days
* Gross revenue retention
* Upsell ARR, including upsells you source
* Outcome attainment: the specific problem each customer switched to solve, defined at kickoff and verified at 90 and 180 days

**Must Haves**

* 2+ years of behavioral health billing experience, enough to talk shop with billers and billing managers: claims, clearinghouse rejections, denials, payment posting, AR
* Experience implementing software or running multi-stakeholder projects, several at a time
* A track record of designing and delivering training to adults, ideally on software
* US-based, available during US business hours with flexibility for escalations

**Nice to Haves**

* CPB, CPC, or CRCR certification
* Experience at an EHR, practice management, or RCM software company
* Experience on a behavioral health platform (Kipu, Dazos, Lightning Step, Sunwave, Ritten, Alleva, others)
* Experience migrating a practice from one billing system to another
* A background in teaching, instructional design, or coaching
* Startup or early-stage company experience
* PMP or PRINCE2

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base salary: $80,000, paid bi-weekly
* Quarterly bonus: up to 8,000 annually), based on KPIs s

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (YouTube Agency)
jobs.description:
Viral Bangers is a fully remote YouTube agency. We write scripts, edit videos and design thumbnails for experts, founders and trading educators, including vidIQ, Jordan Welch and Chamath Palihapitiya. Their channel is a big part of their business, so they care how it's going.

We need the person our clients talk to every day. When a script is late or a thumbnail needs another pass, they hear it from you, along with a plan.

What you'll do

- Check where each client's videos are in ClickUp every morning, and tell each client what's moving and what we still need from them

- Chase whatever is holding things up: raw footage, a script approval, a thumbnail pick

- Turn feedback like "make it punchier" into clear tasks for the editor or writer, and follow up until they're done

- Talk to clients on Slack, sometimes WhatsApp. When a thread passes ten messages, jump on a call or send a Loom

- If a video will be late, tell the client before they ask

- Once a week, go through each client: uploads on time? happy? anything they haven't said?

- Back the team when the client is wrong, and find a fair middle

You're a fit if

- Your English is strong, written and spoken

- You've managed clients directly before (customer success, account management or an agency). Knowing YouTube is a plus

- You reach out when a client goes quiet. Nobody has to tell you

- You stay calm when a client is upset, and you can still say no

Not a fit if you wait for instructions, treat every client the same, or think the client is always right.

Pay

- USD 800/month base, covering your first 5 clients

- USD 160/month for each client after that

- Paid on results, not hours, so it doesn't have to be full time. The first 2-3 weeks take more time while you learn the clients

Apply only through our role page: https://www.viralbangers.com/careers/customer-success-manager

Fill in the form there and paste the link to your Loom (English, on camera, 3 minutes max, answering the 6 questions in the job description; no reading, script or edits). Applications without a Loom aren't reviewed. Applications sent by email or DM aren't reviewed either.

Process (we reply to every step within 24 hours)

1. Apply with the form AND a Loom. Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed.

2. A 45-minute task with 3 real client cases. You have 24 hours.

3. A short call with our team, including a 5-minute role-play where we play an upset client.

4. A paid 1-week trial (USD 200) with 2 real clients. We read your messages before they go out.

The Loom (required, English, 3 minutes max). Answer these 6 questions:

1. Who are you, and where have you managed clients?

2. A new client just signed. How do you build the relationship in the first 30 days?

3. How do you adapt how you talk to different clients? Give a real example.

4. A time you were stuck between a client and your team, and both had a point. What did you do?

5. A client wants to leave. What do you do in the first 48 hours?

6. Which client relationship are you proudest of, and why?

Loom rules: on camera, talking to us like a normal conversation. No reading, no teleprompter, no script and no edits. We reject read or edited Looms automatically. Set the link so anyone with it can view.

Pay: $55,800.00 - $67,300.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Business Development & Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Cryoport Systems is a comprehensive supply chain partner for the life sciences industry, delivering specialized solutions to meet the challenges of the biopharmaceutical, cell and gene therapy, reproductive medicine, and animal health markets. Our offerings span logistics, BioServices and biostorage, cryopreservation, and consulting, ensuring the highest standards of quality and reliability for sensitive materials. With our expansive platform of management solutions and decades of temperature-controlled supply chain expertise, Cryoport Systems helps Enable the Outcome™ by supporting certainty and precision in the supply chain, whether advancing groundbreaking therapies, supporting families on their reproductive journeys, or enhancing animal health programs.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Business Development & Key Account Manager - Americas is responsible for winning and growing medium to large, multi-site customers for Tec4med's real-time condition monitoring solutions across the United States (Americas).

  

The role is primarily focused on new business: building qualified pipeline, leading consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing. Once won, the role-holder owns these accounts long term, expanding usage across sites, lanes and products, while continuing to develop new business pipeline.

The position will be responsible for growing our US territory for Tec4med. The role requires a very hands-on approach and an end-to-end ownership of the sales cycle, including lead generation and cold calling.The role targets customers with medium to large, multi-site monitoring requirements and medium to high shipment or asset volumes, in the following segments:

* End users / shippers - pharmaceutical, biotech, cell & gene therapy and other owners of high value, temperature-sensitive product who acquire the technology directly or specify it to their chosen logistics partners.
* Logistics service providers - 3PLs, freight forwarders, specialty couriers and packaging / asset pool providers who deploy Tec4med within their own services, as customers or as channel partners.
* Target industries - Biopharma (including cell & gene therapy, vaccines and biologics), CRO / CDMO, Laboratories, Animal Health and Reproductive Medicine / IVF, across shipment monitoring and on-site storage monitoring (cryogenic, dry ice / ULT, cold chain and CRT).
* Channel partners - logistics service providers, packaging and asset-pool providers who resell, integrate or white-label Tec4med within their own offering, with joint go-to-market to their end customers.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES (include but are not limited to)**

  

* Generate new business and establish strong relationships with clients in the Americas region, focusing on medium to large, multi-site accounts in the target segments.
* Build and maintain a qualified pipeline in HubSpot that meets agreed coverage targets, and forecast accurately.
* Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles  engaging quality / validation, supply chain, logistics, procurement, IT / security and commercial stakeholders - from discovery through business case, pilot / qualification and contract.
* Prepare and deliver accurate, customer-specific proposals and business cases, including recurring-revenue (service / subscription) models.
* Collaborate with inside sales support to provide accurate quotes and order processing.
* Conduct prospecting, digital outreach (LinkedIn, Email, and others), cold calls and video meetings to engage prospects and provide demos.
* Visit clients regularly to strengthen relationships and address their needs.
* Own won accounts long term: develop account plans for key accounts, drive roll-out across sites, lanes and products, and grow recurring revenue.
* Develop logistics service providers as customers and channel partners, including joint go-to market activity with their end customers.
* Work with Cryoport Systems, MVE and CRYOGENE colleagues on joint opportunities, while building an independent Tec4Med pipeline.
* Work with Customer Success / Validation colleagues to support customer qualification, onboarding and adoption.
* Represent the company at trade shows to increase visibility and generate leads.
* Contribute to developing and executing sales strategies for regional growth.
* Support marketing efforts by aligning campaigns with customer needs and feedback.
* Collect and provide valuable customer feedback to drive product and service improvements.
* Ensure compliance with the companys Quality Management System and processes.
* Key Performance Indicators
  + New logos won (medium to large, multi-site accounts).
  + Order intake and new annual recurring revenue against target.
  + Qualified pipeline value and coverage against target.
  + Account growth / net revenue retention on owned accounts.
  + Balance of new-business and existing-account revenue.
  + Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline (HubSpot).

**COMPETENCIES & PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

  

* Strong technical sales and business development experience in complex, solution-based B2B sales
* Established credibility and network in temperature-controlled, high-value supply chains; e.g. packaging, condition monitoring, specialty transport or life-science logistics
* Consultative, multi-stakeholder selling capability; comfortable engaging from operational level to C-suite
* Hunter mindset, with the discipline to develop and grow accounts over the long term
* Working understanding of GDP / GMP and customer validation / qualification requirements
* Proactive with excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks
* Client-focused with the ability to understand customer needs
* Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and adaptable

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences or Economics, or equivalent professional experience
* Typically 8+ years in B2B technic

Job overview

PharmacyAI is built by community pharmacy owners, who still own and run their own stores. Our first product, Raichel, automates prescription processing inside PioneerRx.

We are hiring our first Customer Success Specialist. Most pharmacies onboard and learn on their own through our self-serve resources. You are the person who steps in when a pharmacy needs extra help or starts to go off track, and you get them back on track.

The role

This is a hands-on, frontline role. You will answer support calls, work support tickets, and coach busy pharmacy staff one-on-one through setup, install and training, all remotely. You will also write up what fixed each issue so the next pharmacy gets the answer faster. It is not a portfolio-style role focused on renewals and expansion.

What you'll do

- Step in when a pharmacy stalls during setup, install or training and get them back on track.

- Provide one-on-one support by phone and through support tickets in HubSpot.

- Write clear, reproducible bug tickets for our engineering team.

- Write clear resolution notes and tag tickets consistently so they feed our knowledge base.

- Flag wrong or outdated answers in AI-drafted replies, and know the knowledge base content well.

- Tell us where pharmacies get stuck so we can improve our self-serve resources.

What we're looking for

- Pharmacy operations experience: a former pharmacy technician, or someone from a pharmacy software vendor. You understand eScript, refill and cycle fill workflows from the pharmacy side.

- Patient with busy, sometimes frustrated pharmacy staff. You can walk someone through a fix or retrain them one-on-one, remotely.

- Methodical troubleshooting. You can diagnose a technical issue and are not intimidated by technical problems.

- Comfortable at an early-stage company where processes are still being built.

- Clear, consistent documentation habits.

Nice to have

- Prior customer success, implementation or support role at a software company.

- PioneerRx experience.

- HubSpot or similar CRM and ticketing experience.

- Experience with AI-assisted support tools.

Why join

- First customer success hire. The team grows from this seat.

- Built by pharmacy owners for community pharmacy.

- Full-time, remote, with paid time off.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Work from home

new_jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
new_jobs.description:
**avfleet.ai** is a FaaS company that operates large scale depots that manage EV and AV fleets. In the Operations Supervisor role, you will lead our Operations Coordinator team and their driver cohorts. You will own the schedule, and be accountable for driver KPIs. If you like solving staffing problems in real time and are passionate about supervising high performing teams then this job is for you.  
  
**What you’ll do**

* Lead the coordinator team. Direct a team of Operations Coordinators who together supervise about 80 drivers — set priorities, resolve escalations, and hold the team accountable for their driver groups.
* Own the schedule. Build driver and Operations Coordinator shift schedules against forecasted volume, manage call-outs, and keep overtime under control.
* Develop people. Coach drivers and coordinators, run performance conversations, handle corrective action and nurture a culture of ownership, collaboration and sense of urgency.
* Keep timekeeping clean. Review and approve driver and coordinator hours, confirm meal and rest periods are recorded correctly, and ensure strict compliance with California wage and hour laws.
* Run the daily numbers. Track attendance, driver KPIs, and exceptions, and propose action plans for improving performance. Own the outcome when things go sideways. Direct the response to on-site incidents and vehicle events, figure out what changed, and make sure it gets reported and fixed.

**What you bring**

* Two or more years supervising or leading an hourly workforce in delivery, logistics, transportation, warehouse, or field operations — or an equivalent combination of experience and training
* Experience building schedules and managing timekeeping for 20 or more hourly employees
* Comfort with scheduling, timekeeping, and dispatch software, and with spreadsheets
* Availability for early morning, evening, and weekend shifts on a rotating basis
* Clear communication — you can coach someone and document it.
* A valid driver’s license, and the ability to meet our vehicle insurability standards and the driving-eligibility requirements of the delivery platforms we operate on. Operating our vehicles is an occasional part of this job, and no other form of transportation substitutes for moving a company van.

**We don’t require a degree for this role.**  
  
**Nice to have**

* Prior experience driving on a rideshare or delivery platform such as Uber or Lyft.
* Experience with EV fleets, charging operations, or other fleet depot operations.
* Working knowledge of California labor laws pertaining to overtime and meal and rest breaks.
* Conversational ability in Spanish.

**The work environment**  
This is an on-site role in an active vehicle yard. You’ll move between the office and the yard throughout the day, occasionally lift items up to 40 pounds, occasionally get in and out of vehicles, and work a schedule that includes early mornings, evenings, and weekends. If you need reasonable accommodation to perform any part of this job, we’ll work through it with you.  
  
**Compensation and benefits**  
Base salary: $72,050 – $75,000 per year. This is the good-faith range we reasonably expect to pay for this position on hire. Where you land in the range depends on your experience, skills, and internal equity.  
We also offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and California paid sick leave.  
  
**How to apply**  
Email your resume and the role you’re applying for to hiring@avfleet.ai  
We read every application — no automated screening, no resume-ranking software. A person reviews your materials.  
  
Equal opportunity and legal notices

The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. new_jobs.description:
**Work Authorization Requirements**

* Must be authorized to work in the United States

**Job Summary:**

The Project Manager oversees all aspects of the project and is responsible for co-ordination and completion of the project performing a variety of tasks. Tasks include analyzing drawings and specifications, setting deadlines, establishing schedules, procuring materials, tools & equipment, and monitoring and documenting progress of the project. The Project Manager may be responsible for more than one project at a time.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Manage projects to ensure that all scopes are completed per industry and job specific standards, and profitably.
* Operate and care for company equipment, vehicles, and small tools.
* Communicate with owners and consulting engineers to create comprehensive bids.
* Perform accurate take-offs.
* Constantly collect current pricing from vendors.
* Ensure all project details, materials, and scope clarifications are communicated and put together for the Foreman and crew.

* Make necessary site visits to help manage the project and ensure the Foreman has all updated plans and owner expectations.
* Communicate with the Foreman about all scheduling issues and needs communicated by the ownership team.

* Must be able to read and understand commercial plans, specs. and details.

* Must demonstrate knowledge and understanding of construction plans, OSHA procedures and requirements, and all aspects of waterproofing products and their installation.
* Must be able to create a comprehensive estimate for any project.
* Must be extremely self-motivated.
* Must be able to stay organized and multi-task current as well as pre and post project duties while also handling projects currently in the bidding process.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* At least two years related experience required.
* Must have a valid driver's license.

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

new_jobs.title: Energy Storage Project Manager (Lost Hills, CA)
new_jobs.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Energy Storage Project Manager will provide leadership and oversight to an individual project. They will collaborate with multiple departments in planning, organizing, and directing the project work across our team, including engineering, scheduling, change management, budgeting, and closeout project documentation.  
  
This role is located full-time on a jobsite in Lost Hills, CA and will require travel. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Work with the project execution team to understand multiple work disciplines along with being a leader in scheduling, cost control, quantity tracking, procurement, client satisfaction, daily jobsite needs, and work activities
* Develop and maintain good relationship with Owner, Engineer, and Subcontractors; develop strategies and skills to build a strong partnership with the Owner, while still ensuring prompt owner notification of impacts and preservation of rights per the Prime Contract
* Maintain timely and accurate reporting to management, particularly with regard to cost forecasting and estimated cost at completion.
* Oversee preparation of project billings; seek to maximize cash flow in and reduce pay cycles through diligent & strategic billing preparation. Prioritize the collection of aged receivables and review their status regularly in Owner meetings and conversations.
* Present and negotiate change orders with owner for timely resolution.
* Coordinate, lead, and document routine project update meetings with client and internal stakeholders regarding the status and progress of the work
* Coordinate with the project team to identify needs, develop scopes of work, and hire appropriate third parties to execute the work
* Extensive coordination with material suppliers to ensure timely deliveries and to develop solutions to logistical and supply-chain challenges.
* Review contract conditions; ensure compliance with all contract terms
* Supervise documentation of all significant project events, e.g., accidents, delays, Change Orders
* Effectively manage project risk; evaluate probability and severity of risk events as they are identified / anticipated and prepare mitigation plans with project team and senior management
* Ensure jobsite office networking services are set-up (copiers/printers/scanners, phone lines, etc.)
* Enforce and promote a culture of safety by implementing and enforcing SOLV standards and OSHA policies, procedures and guidelines
* Assist the site management team in displaying and promoting the company values, tenets and culture while representing the company in a professional manner

**Objectives or Goals to Measure Performance:**

* Project profitability
* Project completed on schedule
* Customer/Client Satisfaction
* Positive project team attitude
* Adherence to Company policies and Corporate Procedures and Electrical Safety Manual
* Work within SE’s business processes and ensure an efficient working environment
* Improved personal professional growth and education
* Staff development and training

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of work-related experience in design and/or construction of utility scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Direct relevant industry experience preferred, skilled with knowledge related to the construction and operation of the electrical equipment and installation
* Leadership ability – able to pull together team members from diverse backgrounds in a remote environment and organize them into a cohesive, high-performing project team.
* Able to travel extensively (potentially more than 50%) including lengthy jobsite-based assignments.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills to work with others under all situations
* Ability to work, analyze, troubleshoot and prioritize problems independently
* Effective written and verbal English communication skills
* Proficiency and knowledgeable in office practices, procedures and equipment
* Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize and coordinate
* P6 scheduling experience preferred

**Physical Demands and Environmental Conditions:**

* Requires frequent stooping, bending, crouching, reaching, handling, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting 50 or more lbs
* Constant finger dexterity and ability to see details at close range and at a distance, hear, talk, and possess depth perception
* Occasional climbing and carrying, proximity to moving mechanical parts, working in high exposed places
Occasional exposure to environmental conditions  

  

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.*

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**

Family & Child Empowerment Services (FACES) provides families who live and work in San Francisco with high-quality early childhood education and enrichment; job support, training, and placement; and comprehensive family support services and referrals. Our mission is to empower families who live and work in San Francisco to transform their futures through evidence-based educational and economic opportunities.

**Position Summary**

As the Operations Coordinator, you are an integrity driven person at the center of the day-to-day operations and activities at the Bayview Child Development Center. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and enjoys delivering great customer service in an educational setting. You have a passion for developing efficient systems to support operations and take pride in maintaining a welcoming, organized and safe environment. You are able to find harmony while holding multiple responsibilities and are thorough with everything you accomplish. You are empathetic and deeply committed to equitable service for all the children, families and staff.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide general administrative support with a preference to support the opening shift at the school, receiving and greeting all visitors, taking on complex copying jobs, front desk reception, and routing center mail and deliveries.
* Communicate with school staff, outside agencies, and parents and families to share information, request and provide materials, resolve issues or concerns (via Learning Genie) or other forms of communication.
* Establish and maintain confidential files/records, including student enrollment, attendance, and contact data.
* Complete data entry required for government grant compliance (student attendance, DPH immunization reporting, meal counts).
* With the Site Supervisor’s, schedule and maintain relationships with substitute teacher vendor agencies and manage scheduling and canceling of subs.
* Coordinate and maintain a schedule, with the Site Supervisor’s, for appropriate classroom coverage including managing breaks and transition times.
* Along the Site Supervisor’s, support center safety including leading emergency response drills and monitoring emergency supply inventory.
* Schedule, coordinate, and monitor contractors and vendors for repairs and ongoing maintenance in partnership with the Director of Operations and Facilities.
* Maintain the overall appearance and functionality of the school environment, including decorating for events, keeping bulletin boards updated, and general upkeep of shared spaces such as entrances and the staff lounge, while consistently prioritizing safety.
* Assist with planning, advertising, and hosting student and family events.
* Assist with school-wide communication, including newsletters, flyers, and brochures.
* Manage centralized inventory of supplies and materials and order center supplies as needed.
* In partnership with the enrollment department, assist with new family orientations and enrollment process including scheduling intakes, participating in educating families on center-based systems.
* Work closely with our partners to maintain compliance and complete monthly reports.
* Identify gaps in operations work and develop systems to support efficiency and sustainability

**Minimum Qualifications**:

*You have a solid mix of the following knowledge, ability, skills and experience:*

* 2-3 years of experience working in a bustling, high energy and dynamic collaborative office environment (school-based environment a plus).
* Completion of at least 12 ECE/CD units ("core"courses such as child growth/development, child/family/community, and curriculum)
* Bilingual (Spanish/English) preferred
* Ability to exercise good judgment and discretion in handling confidential materials and matters.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to details; ability to work accurately, independently and manage multiple projects effectively.
* Ability to frequently lift a range of weight from ten (10) to forty (40) pounds
* Ability to relate and communicate to individuals from diverse ethnic, cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds and to work with them in a fair, supportive and cooperative manner.
* Proficient in computer navigation, communication, MS Office and client database systems
* Ability to meet and maintain required state, federal, local, and CDC standards (including but not limited to fingerprint clearance, negative TB test, First Aid, CPR)
* A deep commitment to aligning all program practices to FACES values, especially around equity, inclusion, and belonging for all our stakeholder
* Strong passion for and a desire to humbly reflect and grow in pursuit of our mission
* Completion of 6-12 ECE units to assist with ratio in the morning or breaks if needed
* A sense of humor- we believe joy and justice go hand in hand!

**What We Offer**

* Hourly rate range is $36.00-$40.00 based on experience
* Healthcare premiums 100% paid for employees and 25% paid for dependents
* Three weeks of vacation, personal and floating holidays, twelve sick days, ten paid holidays (including one-week winter closure between Christmas and New Year’s) and a day off for your birthday!
* A retirement plan with employer match up to 7% of your salary
* A chance to positively impact the lives of young children and their families
* A fun, dynamic and collaborative working environment
* Opportunity to join a movement to achieve educational, economic, and racial justice!

**FACES is a welcoming space for all. We embrace diversity in all forms- race, gender identity, sexuality, country of origin, religion, or ability. Candidates with diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. FACES is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.**

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager, Beverage
new_jobs.description:
**Why choose us?**

Albertsons Companies is at the forefront of the revolution in retail. With a fixation on raising the bar with innovation and building belonging through our culture, our team is rallying our company around a unique purpose***: to create joy around each table and inspire a healthier tomorrow for every community.***

Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, with over 2,200 stores in 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners include Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Shaw's, Acme, Tom Thumb, Randalls, United Supermarkets, Pavilions, Star Market, Haggen, Carr’s, Kings Food Markets, and Balducci's Food Lovers Market. We support our stores with 22 distribution centers and 19 manufacturing plants.

  

**Bring your flavor**

Building the future of food and well-being starts with you. Join our team and bring your best self to the table.

Are you ready to lead a team in a fast-paced production environment? Join us as a Production Supervisor and be a key contributor to our production success. If you excel at motivating teams, managing production lines, and maintaining quality standards, we encourage you to apply.

**What you will be doing**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Manager serves as the site leader for Food Safety, Quality, and Regulatory Compliance at our beverage manufacturing facility. This role is accountable for protecting consumers, safeguarding beverage quality and shelf life, ensuring brand integrity, and enabling business growth.

The QA Manager leads and continuously improves the site’s Food Safety & Quality Management System (FSQMS) to meet and exceed FDA, FSMA, GFSI (such as SQF, BRC, or FSSC 22000), Organic, and customer requirements. Partnering cross-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Product Development, and Commercial teams, this leader mitigates microbiological and physical hazards, drives operational excellence, and supports new beverage commercialization. The role fosters a proactive food safety culture and uses data and continuous improvement tools to strengthen product quality, line capability, and regulatory readiness.

The position will be based in **Richmond, CA**.

  

**Main responsibilities**

* Lead Food Safety & Quality Systems: Own and continuously improve the site FSQMS—including HACCP, FSMA Preventive Controls, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), GFSI standards, Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures (SSOPs), Environmental Monitoring Programs (EMP), and allergen control—to maintain audit readiness and full compliance.
* Beverage & Process Quality Oversight: Oversee quality controls across incoming raw ingredients, water/batching, thermal or cold-chain processing, packaging lines, and finished beverages, including traceability and mock recall programs.
* Regulatory & Audit Leadership: Serve as the primary site contact for local, state, FDA, third-party, and customer audits. Lead inspections, regulatory responses, and timely Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) closure.
* Product Safety Authority: Make final decisions on product release, quality holds, deviations, concessions, and disposition. Oversee analytical and microbiological lab testing, sanitation and CIP verification, and hold/release workflows.
* Quality Team Leadership: Build and lead the QA and lab team through mentorship, clear accountability, strategic hiring, structured onboarding, and ongoing skill development.
* Data-Driven Improvement: Establish beverage quality KPIs and use trend analysis, complaint investigation, and root cause analysis to reduce risk, prevent repeat non-conformances, and drive continuous improvement.
* Supplier & Customer Quality: Lead supplier quality programs and manage customer complaint investigations, trend tracking, and resolution.
* Commercialization & Change Management: Partner with R&D, Operations, and Commercial teams on new product launches, packaging or formula trials, and Management of Change (MOC) to verify food safety and quality standards before execution.

  

**What we are searching for**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in food science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or a related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of progressive QA management experience in food, beverage, or bakery manufacturing.
* Certifications: Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) and HACCP required or attainable shortly after hire; GFSI/SQF Practitioner certification preferred.
* Technical & Regulatory Knowledge: Strong command of FDA/FSMA regulations, GMPs, allergen and sanitation controls, lab/microbiological practices, and CAPA/root cause tools.

Our 290,000 associates have a passion for great service and building lasting relationships with our customers. Through a companywide focus on innovation, we are continually enhancing our digital and product offerings, making it easy for customers to get what they need, wherever they are.

**Business & People Operations Manager**

***Build the systems. Raise the standard. Help great people do great work.***

Explorer Chick is entering its next chapter, and we’re looking for the person who will help define how our people and internal operations grow with it.

We operate more than 30 women’s adventure tours across the U.S. and around the world. Our guests hike mountains, paddle coastlines, rappel waterfalls, trek iconic trails, and take on adventures they may never have imagined themselves doing.

The certification that is current before anyone has to chase it. The payroll input that is right the first time. The policy that is practical, understood, and consistently applied. new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
The **Program Manager of Operations (Cross-Zone Execution)** is a strategic operator on the Cross-Zone Execution team in Operations, which builds the metrics, review forums, playbooks, and engagements that help owners across Aledade deliver on company strategy. Aledade’s work sits in four zones (Performance, Transformation, Incubation, and Foundational), and every department has work in every zone. This role helps owners see how their work is performing, diagnose why a metric is off (“Heart of the Problem”), and decide what to do about it, while the accountable owner stays accountable. The role partners directly with senior leaders and helps build the operating infrastructure of a team that is still being designed. It starts in either metrics and forums or engagements and delivery, and works across both as the team matures.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the U.S. or from our office in Bethesda, MD.

### **Primary Duties:**

* Owns the metric record for each metric in scope, including its definition, owner, source system, target, and review forum, and reconciles definition and gross-versus-net differences before they reach a forum. Keeps the executive dashboard current and accurate, using AI tools to automate status collection and draft pre-reads. Leads the mechanics of review forums, including pre-reads, agendas, decisions, and actions, and tracks actions to closure. Spots variance early and routes it to the metric owner and the Director with a clear recommendation.
* Leads short engagements for owners who ask for help: gathers data, frames the root of the problem (or “Heart of the Problem”), tests competing explanations, writes a one-page scope with an exit date, and drafts recommendations for handoff to the accountable business owner. Tracks funded investments against milestones and flags slippage before the forum. When approved, leads end-to-end projects through plan, dependencies, and readiness to a planned handoff.
* Builds and refines the team’s templates, playbooks, and standards, including Aledade's decision making framework, the meeting standard, and “Heart of the Problem” worksheets. Delivers clinics and onboarding for requesters, coaches colleagues, collects feedback and improves the materials.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
* Alternatively, a Master's degree with 6 years of related experience.
* Ability to travel 10-25% of the time

* Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders
* Structured problem-solving: able to separate competing explanations and say what evidence would tell them apart
* Comfort with data: working in spreadsheets and BI tools, and spotting definition and data errors
* Curiosity and practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day operating work
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders

### **Physical Requirements:**

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

new_jobs.title: Senior Clinical Practice Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPY HEALTH & NUTRITION

Happy Health & Nutrition (HHN) is a growing, founder-led virtual nutrition practice helping adults improve metabolic health and build sustainable habits through evidence-based nutrition care and structured coaching.

Most of our care is currently insurance-based. We are also developing cash-pay programs to serve clients whose needs, goals, or coverage may not fit our insurance-based services.

We believe excellent care depends on excellent operations. Clients should feel welcomed and supported, our team should know who owns each next step, and our referring partners should experience a practice they can trust.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for an experienced private-practice operations leader to help HHN strengthen its operating foundation and prepare for its next stage of growth.

This person will work closely with the founder to identify gaps, understand what is causing them, and lead practical improvements. The work will support a better client experience, stronger follow-through and retention, and reliable systems for managing new inquiries and appropriate client enrollment.

We’re looking for someone with substantial senior-level experience operating a private healthcare or clinical practice and a demonstrated record of helping a practice scale. We value evidence of what you have built and improved over a particular number of years.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can see the larger system, make sound decisions, and help a team follow through. It is not a general assistant position.

WHAT YOU’LL LEAD

* Assess HHN’s workflows and identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, missed handoffs, delays, and unclear ownership.

* Improve the client journey from inquiry and intake through scheduling, ongoing care, follow-up, retention, and transitions.

* Strengthen the systems that help HHN respond to prospective clients, coordinate referrals, and support appropriate enrollment.

* Build and maintain clear workflows, standard operating procedures, handoffs, and team reference materials.

* Create a practical operating rhythm for priorities, owners, deadlines, follow-up, and completion.

* Help the founder turn strategic priorities into sequenced projects with clear accountability.

* Establish useful operational measures for response time, intake completion, first-visit follow-through, retention, capacity, and referral activity.

* Improve how the team uses its CRM and practice systems, including Zoho CRM, SimplePractice, Spruce, and Microsoft Teams/other tools.

* Clarify responsibilities and escalation paths so work is distributed appropriately and the founder or one team member is not the default owner of every open task.

* Support hiring, onboarding, role clarity, and management routines as HHN grows.

* Coordinate with external billing, technology, and other practice partners; track issues and route decisions to the appropriate person.

* Surface recurring client or team concerns, look for root causes, and lead practical solutions.

Clinical judgment, nutrition care, and medical advice remain with HHN’s clinical team. The Operations Manager supports the systems around care and does not make clinical decisions.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

* Senior-level experience operating a private healthcare or clinical practice.

* Demonstrated experience helping a private practice grow, with specific examples of what you personally owned and what improved.

* Experience diagnosing operational problems and implementing solutions that improved service, client retention, capacity, or growth.

* Strong project-management and follow-through skills.

* The judgment to distinguish a process problem from a staffing, capacity, or priority problem.

* Clear, direct, and respectful communication with a founder and a distributed team.

* Comfort building systems that are useful and sustainable, rather than adding process for its own sake.

* Experience with CRMs, practice-management systems, shared documents, and operational reporting.

* A commitment to confidentiality and appropriate handling of client information.

EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE ESPECIALLY HELPFUL

* Nutrition, dietetics, behavioral health, or another virtual private-practice setting.

* Insurance-based services as well as cash-pay services or programs.

* Referral-partner workflows and healthcare billing or revenue-cycle coordination.

* Leading a practice through meaningful growth or a change in its service model.

HOW WE’LL DEFINE EARLY SUCCESS

During the first 90 days, we expect to develop a shared view of HHN’s key workflows and bottlenecks, clarify ownership of priority operational work, improve or document the most important processes, and establish a realistic operating plan the team can maintain. Specific measures will be agreed upon after an initial assessment.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your résumé and a brief response to these questions:

1. What private practice have you helped operate, and what responsibilities did you personally own?

2. Describe a practice you helped scale. What changed in its size, capacity, services, or operating systems?

3. Tell us about an operational problem you identified, how you investigated it, what you changed, and what result followed.

4. What would you want to understand about HHN before recommending operational changes?

Please begin your application with “**Practice Operations Leader.**” Specific examples are more helpful than a high volume of applications.

Experience:

* Senior Operations management: 3 years (Required)
* Private Healthcare or Clinical Practice. : 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

This role combines bookkeeping, financial administration, systems maintenance, CPA coordination and occasional general administrative support.

We are looking for someone who can work independently, take ownership of ongoing responsibilities and help keep our financial and administrative systems accurate, organized and up to date.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a solid foundation in bookkeeping who enjoys learning, improving systems and growing alongside creative, entrepreneurial businesses.

* Experience working with creative businesses, studios, agencies or project-based organizations.
* Familiarity with project-based accounting, budget tracking and forecasting.
